title: Appointment Setter for US Insurance Agency — Objection Handling Required
description:
**Sales-Oriented Appointment Setter — US Insurance (Aged Leads, Phone) — Long-Term**



## Job Type / Terms



- **Type:** Full-time or part-time to start (open to the right person)

- **Schedule:** US business hours — **evening/night shift Philippine time** (you'll be dialing US Central Time windows, roughly 8:00 AM–8:00 PM CT). Must be reliably available in these hours.

- **Pay:** $[6–8]/hour to start + **per-appointment-showed bonus** once ramped (details in interview)

- **Start:** Paid test day first, then ongoing for the right fit



---



## About the Role



I run a US life-insurance agency. I need an experienced, **sales-oriented** appointment setter to call a list of aged mortgage-protection leads (people who previously mailed in a card requesting info) and **book them onto my calendar** for a quick phone appointment.



You are **not** selling and **not** quoting — I handle every insurance conversation myself. Your one job is to reactivate the lead, handle their objections, and lock in a firm same-day phone appointment. You'll dial on a multi-line dialer, follow a proven script, and book straight into my calendar.



This is a **long-term seat** for someone who's genuinely good on the phone. I'll give you the script, the system, and the leads. I need you to bring the phone skill.



---



## What You'll Do



- Make outbound calls to aged mortgage-protection leads on a multi-line dialer (expect 500–800 dials/day)

- Follow my reactivation script to warm the lead back up

- **Handle objections** — "I don't remember filling that out," "I already have insurance," "I'm not interested," "I'm busy" — and steer back to booking

- Book firm **same-day** phone appointments onto my calendar

- Confirm the callback number and pre-frame the appointment so the lead shows up

- Log dispositions cleanly after each call



---



## Who I'm Looking For (please read before applying)



**Required:**

- **Prior phone appointment-setting or telesales experience** — ideally US insurance, but strong US B2C phone experience counts

- **Excellent spoken English** — clear, warm, confident, easy for an older US homeowner to understand

- **Real objection-handling ability** — you can take a "no" or a "maybe" and turn it into a booked appointment without being pushy or robotic

- Comfortable on a dialer and hitting daily call volume

- Reliable internet, a quiet space, a good headset, and availability during US calling hours (your evening/night)

- Coachable — you'll follow my script and take feedback



**Not a fit if:**

- You've only done data entry, general VA work, or chat/email support (this is phone sales)

- You read scripts word-for-word and freeze when someone objects

- You're uncomfortable being on the phone all day

- You need daytime-PH-only hours



---



## How to Apply (follow this exactly — it's my first filter)



Applications that don't follow these steps get skipped. Applications that do move straight to a live interview.



1. Start your reply with the word **"HOMEOWNER"** so I know you read the whole post.

2. In 3–4 sentences, tell me about your **most relevant phone/appointment-setting experience** — what you sold or set, for what kind of business, and roughly how many dials/day you ran.

3. Record a **1–2 minute voice recording** (any format — Vocaroo link is fine) with **two parts**:



   - **Part A — read this exactly as you'd say it on a real call:** *

"Mr. Johnson, good afternoon to you, sir. This is [your name]… [John], how you doing today? So I'm calling from the office of the field underwriter assigned to your mortgage there — a while back you got a notice in the mail about mortgage protection. Is that ringing a bell?"*



   - **Part B — now stay in character:** I answer and say *"I don't really remember filling anything out."* Reactivate me and try to book me for a quick call this evening.



   Part A shows me your delivery and English on real script wording; Part B shows me how you think on the phone when someone pushes back. I want to hear both.



That voice sample matters more than your résumé. If you're good on the phone, I'll know in the first thirty seconds. **Strong applications will be invited to a quick WhatsApp interview.**



---



## Why Work With Me



- Clear script and system — you're set up to win, not thrown to the wolves

- Long-term, stable seat for the right person (I'm not looking to churn setters)

- Performance bonus on top of hourly once you're ramped — you make more when you book real appointments that show

- Straightforward manager — I'll tell you exactly what "good" looks like and help you hit it

title: Patient Care Coordinator
description:
Position Summary:

The Patient Care Coordinator plays a key role in supporting patients throughout their care journey. This role focuses on scheduling, communication, prescription coordination, and ensuring patients feel heard, guided, and cared for from the first point of contact through ongoing care. Prompt responsiveness and compassionate communication are essential in this role.



Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for patient inquiries via phone,
, and messaging systems

• Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments

• Provide clear and compassionate communication regarding appointments, policies, and next steps

• Coordinate with clinical and administrative teams to support patient needs

• Follow up with patients regarding missed appointments or cancelled appointments

• Verify and update patient information in the electronic health record system

• Manage prescription refill requests in coordination with providers

• Contact pharmacies as needed to resolve prescription issues and ensure timely dispensing

• Ensure patients feel supported, informed, and cared for at every step



Qualifications:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• High level of empathy, patience, and professionalism

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

• Comfortable using electronic health record or scheduling systems

• Experience in behavioral health or psychiatry is a plus but not required

• HIPAA/PHI experience



How to Apply:

Please submit your resume and include a short introduction video (30–60 seconds) sharing why you believe you are a strong fit for this role. Applications missing either requirement will NOT be considered. 



Benefits

- Long-term, stable position with consistent hours

- Paid lunch break and holidays

- Supportive and professional work environment

- Opportunity to grow with a growing U.S. healthcare practice

title: Client Relationship Manager | No Graveyard Shift - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Research Editor & Fact-Checker - AI Start Up
description:
EchoVerse Collective - Research Editor & Fact-Checker



We build agents for humans. EchoVerse Collective is an AI-native media, content and intelligence company. Our flagship publication is Dispatches. You can read it at 
.



Dispatches uses AI agents to research, challenge and draft public-interest articles. We are hiring an experienced Research Editor to make the final human decision before an article is published, and to help the system learn from what you find.



You will check the evidence, challenge the argument and improve the writing. You will have the authority to approve, return, reject or escalate an article. That responsibility matters more than getting another piece out of the door.



THE WORK



- Verify material claims against credible primary evidence and high-quality secondary sources. Check that citations support the claims being made.

- Assess accuracy, context and fairness. Make uncertainty clear and distinguish fact, analysis and opinion.

- Identify missing perspectives and credible counterarguments without giving unsupported claims equal weight.

- Challenge weak sourcing, misleading framing, unsupported certainty and sensationalism.

- Edit for structure, clarity, tone and natural British English, preserving a distinctive voice where it serves the reader.

- Identify legal, ethical, reputational or safeguarding concerns and escalate issues that require specialist judgement.

- Make and record a clear publishing decision, with concise reasons and specific changes where needed.

- Spot recurring weaknesses and turn them into practical feedback on prompts, research methods, source selection, evaluation criteria and editorial workflows.

- Help maintain editorial standards as Dispatches expands its coverage.



YOUR EDITORIAL AUTHORITY



You are the final human publishing approver. You can approve an article, return it with required changes, reject it, or escalate it for specialist or senior review. You must have the evidence, context and time needed to make that decision.



No publishing target overrides accuracy, fairness or source integrity. Silence never counts as approval. Every approval must be attributable to a named human editor.



YOU WILL FIT IF



- You have relevant experience in editing, journalism, fact-checking, research, policy or another profession where evidence and judgement are central.

- You write excellent English and can improve a piece without flattening its voice.

- You can find and interpret primary evidence, spot flawed reasoning, and recognise when a conclusion goes beyond its sources.

- You follow current affairs and are curious about technology, business, politics, science, culture and social trends.

- You are comfortable investigating unfamiliar subjects and admitting when you need expert input. Nobody is expected to know every subject in advance.

- You can stop publication when the evidence is not strong enough, and explain why clearly and constructively.

- You are comfortable with AI-assisted research and writing, while checking outputs independently. Fluency is not evidence.

- You work reliably from written briefs, communicate what is complete and what remains unresolved, and never report a result you have not verified.



Tell us if you have experience in investigations, verification, open-source research, media law, responsible reporting, editorial standards or quality-assurance processes. These are useful additions; sound research and editorial judgement are the core requirements.



HOW WE WILL KNOW IT IS WORKING



Material errors are caught before publication. Published work is accurate, well sourced, fair and clear. Decisions are consistent and documented, turnaround is dependable, and recurring weaknesses decrease because your feedback helps prevent them. We assess the quality of your judgement as well as delivery.



DETAILS AND PACKAGE



- Full-time, fully remote, Philippines. Independent contractor with EchoVerse Collective Limited, with monthly invoicing.

- Base salary: negotiable, depending on relevant experience and editorial judgement. Please include your expected monthly base salary in PHP. The allowances below are additional to base pay.

- Required publishing window: 03:00-10:00 UK local time on your agreed working days. That is 10:00-17:00 in the Philippines during British Summer Time, and 11:00-18:00 during UK winter time. Working days, total weekly hours and cover arrangements are agreed before the paid trial.

- 13th-month bonus.

- PHP 10,000 monthly family fund, paid on top of base salary, with no receipts required.

- PHP 4,200 monthly private healthcare allowance to help fund cover for you and your family.

- 15 days of paid leave each year.

- 20% of paid working time protected for learning, with a PHP 30,000 annual learning budget. Learning time is scheduled alongside editorial review responsibilities and agreed cover.

- Company-funded equipment, tools and AI subscriptions needed for the role, with the setup agreed before you start.

- Base salary reviews at six and twelve months. The full package and trial terms will be set out in your engagement letter before you start.



HOW TO APPLY - two things, both required



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph, with your answers in the application message and links to your work. Check that we can open the links.



1. Two or three examples of research, editing or fact-checking work. For each, explain your contribution and what it demonstrates. A short explanation of your relevant experience is enough; select the work you can discuss in detail.

2. One concrete example of a claim or article you challenged. What looked wrong or incomplete, which evidence did you check, and what did you d
? Explain any uncertainty that remained. A few hundred words is plenty.



Also include your expected monthly base salary in PHP, availability to start and ability to meet the working pattern above.



Subject line: Dispatches editor - [your name]



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid editorial work sample: review an AI-produced article, its sources and its internal challenge notes, then explain whether it should be approved, revised, rejected or escalated. We assess judgement, evidence and clarity, not speed alone. The scope and fee are agreed before you start, and everyone we ask to complete the sample is paid on delivery, whether or not they are hired.



That is followed by an interview about your decisions and a paid trial reviewing a small, varied batch of articles before a longer commitment. Review volumes, publication deadlines and escalation arrangements are agreed during the trial so that the workload allows meaningful checking. Trial terms and pay are agreed in advance. Only work that passes the normal editorial approval process can be published.

title: Payroll Officer + Bookkeeper
description:
BOOKKEEPER & PAYROLL OFFICER



We’re looking for a highly organised, switched-on Bookkeeper & Payroll Officer to take ownership of the financial admin side of our growing business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who genuinely loves numbers, systems, accuracy and keeping everything clean and up to date.



You’ll be responsible for making sure our Xero is completely reconciled, our payroll is processed correctly every fortnight, our receipts and records are properly documented, and our financial projections accurately reflect what is happening inside the business.



THE ROLE



You’ll be responsible for:



XERO & BOOKKEEPING

→ Managing all day-to-day transactions in Xero

→ Reconciling Xero every fortnight

→ Ensuring every transaction is correctly categorised

→ Attaching receipts and supporting documentation to every relevant transaction

→ Identifying and resolving discrepancies

→ Keeping accounts clean, accurate and up to date

→ Following up on anything that is missing or unclear

→ Maintaining strong financial record keeping and organisation



PAYROLL

→ Processing payroll every fortnight

→ Ensuring payroll is accurate and completed on time

→ Managing employee records and payroll-related administration

→ Ensuring superannuation and other payroll obligations are correctly handled

→ Keeping payroll records organised and up to date



BAS & COMPLIANCE

→ Preparing BAS on the required schedule

→ Working with our accountant/tax professional where required

→ Ensuring Xero is properly reconciled and ready for BAS lodgement

→ Keeping all relevant financial records organised and accurate



FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS



This is an important part of the role.



We maintain a financial projection spreadsheet that tracks our current and expected revenue based on active clients.



You’ll be responsible for keeping this updated so we always have a clear picture of our projected revenue.



For example:



A client signs → add them to the projection.



A client cancels → remove them and update the projection.



A client changes their package or payment amount → update the projection.



A new client starts → add them to the projection.



We want to be able to look at the spreadsheet at any point and clearly understand:



→ Current recurring revenue

→ Expected future revenue

→ Upcoming changes to revenue

→ Client cancellations

→ New clients

→ Revenue gaps

→ What our projected monthly revenue looks like moving forward



This needs to be maintained accurately and consistently, not updated once every few months.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’ll be a great fit if you:



→ Have strong experience with Xero

→ Have experience processing Australian payroll

→ Understand BAS and GST requirements

→ Are extremely organised and detail-oriented

→ Naturally notice discrepancies and missing information

→ Are comfortable working independently

→ Take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do

→ Are reliable with deadlines

→ Have excellent attention to detail

→ Are confident working with spreadsheets and financial projections

→ Can communicate clearly when something needs clarification

→ Actually enjoy keeping financial systems clean and organised



EXPERIENCE WITH



Xero is essential.



Experience with Australian payroll, superannuation, BAS and GST is essential.



Experience working with service-based businesses, agencies or businesses with recurring clients would be highly regarded.



THE WORKING RHYTHM



This role will have a consistent fortnightly rhythm.



Every two weeks, you’ll be responsible for ensuring Xero is fully reconciled and up to date, receipts are attached, payroll is processed, and our financial projection spreadsheet reflects the current state of the business.



We want someone who can become the person we trust to know exactly what is happening financially behind the scenes.



This is not a role where things should sit untouched until month-end.



We want the books clean. The numbers current. The payroll done. The projections accurate.



If something is missing, we want you to notice it.



If something doesn’t reconcile, we want you to investigate it.



If a client cancels, we want the projection updated.



If there is something we need to know, we want you to tell us.



TO APPLY



Please send through:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience

2. Your experience with Xero

3. Your experience processing Australian payroll

4. Your experience with BAS/GST

5. The types of businesses you have previously worked with

6. Your availability

7. Your hourly rate or proposed monthly/fortnightly fee

8. Your preferred working arrangement



Please also tell us what you believe the most important thing is when keeping the books of a growing business accurate and up to date.



We’re looking for someone who wants to take ownership of this role and become a trusted part of the business long-term.

title: Pre-Litigation Case Manager
description:
FIRM | Remote | Full-time

About us

FIRM is a plaintiff personal injury firm handling catastrophic injury, trucking and commercial vehicle collisions, wrongful death, premises liability, and medical malpractice. We carry a few hundred active files and we are growing. Our clients are usually having the worst year of their lives when they call us, and how they are treated between the signed contract and the demand package is most of what they remember about us.

What the job actually is

You own the pre-litigation file. From the day the contract is signed until the case either settles or gets referred out for suit, you are the person the client calls and the person who knows where everything stands.

Day to day that means:

Calling clients on a set schedule, not just when something happens. Most of our complaints from clients in this phase come down to silence, and we do not allow silence.

Tracking treatment. Knowing who is treating, who stopped going, who needs a referral, and flagging gaps before they become a defense argument.

Ordering and chasing medical records and bills, and staying on providers until the file is complete.

Handling liens, letters of protection, and health insurance and Medicare or Medicaid issues, with help from the paralegal on the complicated ones.

Running the property damage side, rental, total loss, and repairs, so the client is not stranded.

Keeping the case management system accurate. If it is not in the system, it did not happen.

Building the demand package once treatment ends, so the attorney gets a file that is ready instead of a pile.

You report to the general paralegal with pre-litigation authority and you work alongside an attorney, a litigation paralegal, and a legal assistant on your team.

What we are looking for

Two years or more in personal injury pre-litigation is the strong preference. If you have worked defense or claims adjusting and want to come across the aisle, we will hear you out. What matters more than the resume is whether you can hold twenty five to forty files in your head, return every call the same day, and tell a supervising attorney bad news early instead of hoping it resolves itself.

Spanish and English is a real advantage here and affects pay.

You should be comfortable in a cloud case management system. We will train you on ours. You should be comfortable on the phone with a client who is angry, or crying, or convinced nothing is happening. That part we cannot train.

Working remote

This seat is fully remote, and it comes with the obligations that go with that. You need a private place to work where you can take client calls without background noise, and internet that does not drop in the middle of a recorded statement. You are expected online and reachable during Central time business hours, on camera for team meetings, and responsive on chat during the day. Files move here the same way they move in an office, which means you stay visible in the system and nobody has to wonder whether a task got done.

What we offer

Compensation is based on experience, and we will talk about it honestly in the first conversation rather than making you guess. Health coverage, paid time off, and paid holidays. A firm small enough that the managing partner knows your name and what is on your desk, and growing fast enough that there is somewhere to go from here. Several people on our staff started in one seat and are now in another.

Full-Time | Long-Term Leadership Role

After successful completion, move to $2,500 per month plus performance-based bonuses.

- Monday to Friday schedule: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours per week.

- Flexible working hours

- Reliable monthly payments via Wise

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear salary progression after trial

- Real ownership and leadership responsibility

- Direct collaboration with senior leadership

- Clear path to senior leadership or director level

- Access to paid AI tools and systems

- High-growth environment

- Strong company culture



TASKS



- Lead and manage CSMs, onboarding managers, and content support roles

- Monitor daily reports and team performance

- Audit onboarding calls, client calls, DMs, and check-ins

- Run weekly team training and review calls

- Identify underperformers early and take action

- Oversee CRM health in Airtable

- Improve reporting systems and dashboards

- Align Customer Success with Sales and leadership

- Improve onboarding, escalation, churn rescue, and upsell SOPs

- Fix operational gaps and build scalable systems

- Help interview and train new team members

- Proactively identify at-risk clients

- Oversee refund and dispute handling

- Solve root causes behind churn



This is a leadership role. You are trusted to own outcomes, not be micromanaged on tasks.

If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of experience in customer success operations, community management, or similar

- Experience managing 20 to 30 team members

- Strong Airtable, Slack, and Google Workspace experience

- Experience building SOPs, dashboards, and reporting systems

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Self-starter mentality

- Comfortable working across multiple time zones



OPTIONAL BUT PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Restructuring customer success teams

- High-ticket coaching or online education

- Knowledge of churn analysis and lifecycle metrics

- Experience in customer success agency environment



Fill in the form to apply: 
/to/CrESPfAw



Important note: Put "CS OPS" + [Your Name & Family Name] in the "Name" field in the form.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired for this position, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Marketing & Revenue Specialist |US Wellness Business
description:
We are a growing float therapy and wellness spa in the US looking for someone to own our digital marketing and customer follow-up system.



This is not a social media posting or content creation role. We already have franchise-provided graphics, videos, copy, and offers. We need someone who can put those assets to work and build systems that turn leads and existing customers into bookings, memberships, and repeat business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Manage and optimize Meta/Facebook and Instagram ads

- Run
 campaigns through Mailchimp and SMS campaigns through our franchise system

- Work with our CRM/customer database to organize, clean, and segment customer data

- Build follow-up systems for leads, first-time guests, inactive customers, and canceled members

- Create and maintain funnels and automations

- Track the journey from lead -> booking -> membership

- Provide simple reporting on campaign and revenue performance weekly

- Coordinate with our in-spa team when their involvement is needed



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Hands-on Meta Ads experience. We need someone who can actually set up, test, monitor, and optimize campaigns

-  Experience working with CRMs or customer databases

- Experience with
 marketing, SMS, funnels, or automation

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to figure things out independently

- Someone who can look at a messy setup and build a practical system without needing step-by-step instructions

- Clear communication and strong follow-through



NOT REQUIRED

- Boulevard experience. We can teach you the platform

- Graphic design or content creation

- Experience personally doing every manual follow-up. We're more interested in someone who can build and own the system



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your Meta Ads experience and examples of campaigns you've managed

2. An example of a CRM, customer database, funnel, or automation system you've built or improved

3. Your availability

4. Your expected hourly rate

5. Please answer this question:

Imagine you join us and discover that we have leads, customer data, inactive customers, and canceled members, but no consistent follow-up system. What would you do in your first 30 days to understand the current setup and start building a system?



Please start your application with "REACTIVATE" so we know you read the post.



We'd love to hear from you!

title: full-Time QuickBooks Bookkeeper / Accounts Assistant from the Philippines
description:
I am hiring a long-term remote Bookkeeper / Accounts Assistant from the Philippines.



**Individual applicants only — no agencies or BPO companies.**



**Schedule – U.S. Eastern Time / New York:**

• Monday–Thursday:  10:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

• Friday: shorter hours, somewhat flexible

• Approximately 30–35 hours per week



**Responsibilities:**

• QuickBooks: enter vendor bills, reconcile bank and credit card accounts, prepare invoices, and match deposits/payments to invoices

• Manage Accounts Receivable and, Accounts Payable

• Enter customer payments into our sales/accounting systems — training will be provided

• Follow up on outstanding customer balances and collections

• Respond to customer
s regarding invoices, pricing corrections, statements, payments, and account questions

• Update, maintain, and organize Google Sheets

• Organize files and documents in Google Drive

• Review transactions and help identify discrepancies or missing information

• Communicate with employees, salespeople, customers, or vendors when information is needed by phone call 

• Help with reports, follow-ups, data entry, and other office/accounting work



**Very Important:**

This position is not limited only to the responsibilities listed above.



We are looking for someone who is flexible and willing to take on new tasks as they come up. Some assignments may be small administrative tasks, research, follow-ups, organizing information, contacting someone, updating a spreadsheet, checking something online, or helping solve a new problem.



You should be comfortable learning new things and not have the attitude of, “This is not part of my job.”



We want someone who can grow with the company, take ownership of their work, and become a dependable person we can rely on for different types of business tasks.



**Requirements:**

• Strong QuickBooks experience is required

• Bookkeeping/accounting experience is required

• Experience with Google Sheets and Google Drive

• Very organized and detail-oriented

• Reliable and responsible

• Good written and spoken English

• Comfortable communicating by
 and by phone

• Able to work independently

• Able to follow instructions carefully

• Able to learn new systems and responsibilities

• Comfortable asking questions when needed

• Also willing to try to figure things out independently before immediately asking for help

• Must be proactive and follow through on assignments

• Must be available during the U.S. Eastern Time schedule listed above

• Looking for a long-term position

• Individual applicants only — no agencies/BPO companies



**Pay:**

$3.75–$4.00 per hour to start, depending on experience and qualifications.



There is opportunity for increased responsibility, additional hours, and growth for the right person.



**To apply, please answer ALL of the following questions:**



1. How many years of bookkeeping experience do you have?



2. How many years have you worked with QuickBooks? Please explain what you personally did inside QuickBooks.



3. Have you handled Accounts Receivable? Please describe your experience.



4. Have you handled Accounts Payable? Please describe your experience.



5. Have you reconciled bank accounts and credit cards in QuickBooks?



6. Have you matched customer deposits or payments to invoices before? Please explain briefly.



7. How comfortable are you with Google Sheets? What kinds of spreadsheets or reports have you worked with?



8. Are you comfortable communicating directly with customers by
 regarding invoices, balances, collections, or corrections?



9. This position sometimes includes tasks that are not specifically bookkeeping — for example, research, organizing information, updating spreadsheets, following up with someone, or learning a new system. Are you comfortable with that?



10. If you are given a task you have never done before, what would you normally do?



11. Are you currently working for another company? If yes, how many hours per week?



12. Are you able to work approximately Monday–Thursday, 10:00 AM–5 PM New York time, with shorter hours on Friday?



13. What hourly rate are you requesting?



14. What is your internet speed?



15. Do you have a backup internet connection and backup power in case of an outage?



16. Are you applying as an individual, or are you part of an agency/BPO company?



17. Why did you leave your last job, or why are you looking to leave your current job?



18. Are you looking for a long-term position?



19. Please tell me briefly why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



**Please answer each question separately and number your answers 1–19. Applications that do not answer the questions may not be considered.**

title: Creative Executive Assistant & Content Operations Coordinator
description:
Creative Executive Assistant & Content Operations Coordinator



**Company: DeVos Media Productions**



DeVos Media Productions is a growing, faith-based video marketing company serving businesses throughout West Texas. We produce cinematic media, social content, and creative marketing campaigns for clients in real estate, HVAC, luxury home styling, and the title industry.



We are looking for a highly organized, creative, and forward-thinking Virtual Assistant to work closely with the owner and help manage the day-to-day operations of our client accounts.



This is primarily an **executive assistant, project coordination, Canva, and content-planning position**. It is not a professional videographer or advanced video-editing role. We already have a professional editor who handles our larger cinematic projects.



The right person will help turn creative ideas into organized action plans, anticipate upcoming needs, coordinate projects, and ensure that nothing falls through the cracks.



## The Purpose of This Role



The owner of DeVos Media Productions handles client relationships, filming, sales, and creative direction. Your responsibility will be to help organize those ideas, maintain the production workflow, and plan the next steps for each client.



We need someone who can do more than wait for instructions.



You should be able to review a client’s account, understand their goals, and proactively recommend what should happen next. This could include recognizing that a client needs a new carousel, planning next month’s content, identifying missing brand assets, preparing a shoot outline, or following up with an editor before a deadline.



The goal is to create enough organization and forward planning that the owner does not have to personally strategize every small next step.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Executive and Organizational Support



* Help the owner stay organized across multiple clients, projects, shoots, and deadlines.

* Maintain a clear overview of active projects, upcoming deliverables, and unfinished assignments.

* Turn conversations, voice notes, and creative ideas into organized task lists and action plans.

* Help prioritize daily and weekly responsibilities.

* Identify loose ends, missing information, approaching deadlines, and potential problems.

* Provide clear progress updates without requiring the owner to request them.

* Prepare weekly summaries of completed work, current priorities, and upcoming needs.

* Follow up on delegated assignments and help hold the production team accountable.

* Reduce the amount of information and unfinished work the owner must keep track of mentally.



### Proactive Planning and Creative Strategy



* Think ahead about what each client may need next.

* Review client content calendars and recommend upcoming topics, campaigns, or deliverables.

* Help create monthly and weekly content plans for each account.

* Identify gaps in content, branding, scheduling, or project preparation.

* Turn the owner’s creative vision into practical timelines, checklists, and assignments.

* Conduct basic research to support content ideas and client campaigns.

* Help plan seasonal campaigns, social media series, shoot concepts, and promotional content.

* Prepare ideas before meetings so the owner can make decisions quickly.

* Learn each client’s goals, audience, brand voice, and visual identity.

* Present thoughtful recommendations instead of only waiting for step-by-step instructions.



This person will not be solely responsible for developing the company’s strategy, but they should be able to help carry the vision forward and anticipate logical next steps.



### Client Project Management



* Maintain a master list of deliverables for each client.

* Track projects from initial idea through production, editing, approval, scheduling, and publication.

* Create project briefs and assign clear deadlines.

* Monitor the status of videos, photographs, carousels, captions, thumbnails, and scheduled posts.

* Coordinate with the professional video editor and provide the correct files, instructions, branding assets, and deadlines.

* Track revisions and confirm that requested changes are completed.

* Make sure approved content reaches the correct platform on time.

* Flag anything that could delay a project or client delivery.



### Google Drive and File Organization



* Organize raw video footage and photography after each shoot.

* Create consistent folders for each client, shoot, and deliverable.

* Label files clearly by client, date, project, location, and content type.

* Separate raw media, editing assets, working drafts, revisions, approved content, and final deliverables.

* Place footage and instructions in the appropriate folders for the professional editor.

* Maintain organized libraries of logos, headshots, brand guides, templates, music, and reusable assets.

* Ensure that important files are easy to locate and are not a
 overwritten or deleted.

* Keep Google Drive organized as the number of clients and projects increases.



### Canva Content Creation



* Create and update content using established Canva templates.

* Produce Instagram carousels, educational graphics, property posts, before-and-after designs, promotional graphics, covers, and thumbnails.

* Update templates with new images, text, statistics, contact information, and calls to action.

* Maintain the correct fonts, colors, layouts, and branding for every client.

* Create visually clean, professional content without disrupting the established design system.

* Resize and export content for the appropriate social media platforms.

* Organize Canva folders, templates, client brand kits, and completed designs.

* Use good judgment regarding spacing, readability, hierarchy, and visual consistency.



Advanced graphic design is not required, but the candidate must be confident in Canva and have a strong eye for clean, professional content.



### Social Media Scheduling



* Maintain content calendars for DeVos Media Productions and its clients.

* Upload and schedule approved posts through Metricool.

* Schedule content across Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube, and other assigned platforms.

* Add approved captions, hashtags, locations, calls to action, contact information, and disclaimers.

* Confirm that every post uses the correct media, caption, client account, platform, date, and time.

* Balance the schedule so similar topics or visual styles are not repeatedly posted together.

* Maintain a scheduling report showing what has been scheduled and when it will be published.

* Identify empty dates or missing content before they become urgent.



### Content and Quality Control



* Review all graphics, carousels, captions, and scheduled posts before publication.

* Check spelling, grammar, formatting, logos, contact information, disclaimers, and calls to action.

* Confirm that every deliverable follows the correct client brand guidelines.

* Check that posts are properly sized and formatted for each platform.

* Review work from editors and identify obvious mistakes, missing instructions, or inconsistencies.

* Confirm that revisions have been completed correctly.

* Catch preventable mistakes before content reaches the client or the public.



### Light Video and Photo Support



Professional cinematic editing is not the primary responsibility of this position.



The VA may occasionally be asked to:



* Trim simple clips.

* Resize videos for different platforms.

* Add basic captions, logos, music, or calls to action.

* Export simple social media content.

* Crop, resize, or lightly enhance photographs.

* Create basic reels or slideshows from approved content.



Complex commercials, cinematic real estate videos, and major client edits will be handled by our professional video editor.



## Tools Provided



DeVos Media Productions will provide access to the tools needed for the position, including:



* Canva

* Metricool

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Google Drive

* Google Docs

* Google Sheets

* Other approved organizational or editing tools



Candidates do not need to purchase these subscriptions personally. However, they should already understand—or be willing to quickly learn—how to use them effectively.



AI tools may be used to help develop content ideas, captions, briefs, checklists, calendars, and project plans. All AI-assisted work must still be reviewed for accuracy, natural wording, brand consistency, and professionalism.



## Required Qualifications



* Excellent organization and time-management skills.

* Strong written and verbal English communication.

* Confidence using Canva for professional social media content.

* Experience organizing files and projects in Google Drive.

* Familiarity with social media scheduling and content calendars.

* Comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI-assisted tools.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to manage several clients and deadlines simultaneously.

* Ability to follow an established brand guide and content strategy.

* Proactive mindset and willingness to think ahead.

* Good judgment when determining priorities and next steps.

* Ability to work independently after receiving the necessary context.

* Willingness to ask clear questions when important information is missing.

* Dependable communication and consistent availability.

* Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.



## Preferred Experience



* Executive assistant or online business manager experience.

* Project management for a creative agency or social media company.

* Real estate, home-service, interior design, HVAC, or local-business marketing.

* Creating Instagram carousels, social graphics, and thumbnails.

* Managing multiple client content calendars.

* Coordinating with remote editors or creative contractors.

* Writing or refining social media captions.

* Performing content quality control.

* Turning voice notes or rough ideas into organized project plans.



## The Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is equal parts organized assistant, creative problem-solver, and project coordinator.



You take ownership of assignments and do not require repeated reminders. You notice when something is missing, understand how one task affects another, and communicate before a potential problem becomes urgent.



You are comfortable saying things such as:



* “This client only has two weeks of content remaining, so I prepared ideas for next month.”

* “The editor is missing two files, so I organized and sent them.”

* “This carousel needs a stronger call to action before we schedule it.”

* “We have a seasonal opportunity coming up, so I prepared a campaign outline.”

* “These three deliverables are due this week, and this is the order I recommend completing them.”

* “The client’s content is becoming repetitive, so I developed several new content categories.”



We want someone who can learn the owner’s vision, understand the different clients, and eventually help guide routine next steps without needing every decision to be explained individually.



Because DeVos Media Productions is a faith-based company, candidates should be comfortable working around Christian values and occasional faith-based messaging. You do not have to share every belief, but you must respect the company’s mission, values, clients, and creative direction.



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your relevant experience.

2. Examples of Canva graphics, social media carousels, or content calendars you have created.

3. A description of your experience as an executive assistant, project coordinator, or social media assistant.

4. An example of a time you anticipated a client’s or manager’s needs without being given step-by-step instructions.

5. A description of how you organize multiple clients, deadlines, and deliverables.

6. Your experience with Canva, Metricool, ChatGPT, Claude, Google Drive, and similar tools.

7. Your availability, time zone, preferred weekly hours, and expected rate.

8. A description of how you would organize raw footage, editing instructions, drafts, revisions, and final deliverables.

9. Confirmation that you are comfortable working with faith-based content.



Please begin your application with the phrase **“Creative Vision”** so we know you carefully read the complete description.

title: AI App Builder — Build Revenue-Generating AI Governance & Compliance Tools
description:
The Opportunity

Most businesses fall into one of two camps: they haven't adopted AI yet and don't know where to start, or they're already using AI with no guardrails, no audit trail, and no real plan for protecting the customer data they're feeding into it. That gap is the business. I need someone who can turn it into working, paid products — fast.



I'd rather launch something simple that works and starts earning money in the first few weeks than wait months for something perfect. This is a serious, ongoing opportunity for the right person — not a training ground.



Please read before applying: If you don't have hands-on experience independently building and launching complete AI-powered applications, please don't apply. I'm not evaluating potential — I'm evaluating what you've already shipped. Applications without real project examples will not be considered.



What You'd Be Building

- An AI Audit Tool — helps a business evaluate its current AI usage, flag risk areas, and generate a clear findings report.

- An AI Risk & Guardrails Assessment — walks a business through what safety guardrails they should have in place, surfaces gaps, and generates ready-to-use SOPs and policy documentation they can act on immediately.

- A Data Protection / Customer Data Safeguarding Tool — helps businesses document and demonstrate how they're protecting customer data — critical for companies that collect customer information but can't yet show a regulator, auditor, or customer that it's actually safeguarded.

- AI readiness assessments, training platforms, and subscription portals — account sign-up, AI-driven scoring or analysis, and paid access to results or reports.



Every build needs working accounts/login, a functioning AI feature, and a real payment/subscription mechanism. An app that can't generate revenue isn't finished.



Tools You Should Know

I specifically want experience with ChatGPT and GPT Astra, alongside at least one no-code/low-code builder (e.g., Lovable, Base44, Replit) and at least one AI coding tool (e.g., Claude Code, Codex). You don't need every tool on this list — but you need real depth in at least one builder and one AI coding tool, plus comfort working across the ChatGPT ecosystem specifically.



What You Need to Bring

- Personally built and launched at least one working app or platform — not a tutorial project, not a prototype that never shipped.

- Practical experience integrating AI models via API, with the judgment to catch when AI output is wrong, incomplete, or unreliable.

- Experience setting up payments/subscriptions (Stripe or similar).

- Required: hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or GrowthHub 365.

- Ability to troubleshoot and fix problems yourself — not just re-prompt and hope.

- Understanding of AI governance, data privacy, or compliance concepts is a strong plus — this work sits at the intersection of AI functionality and risk/data protection.



How This Will Work

- I bring the business idea and target outcome. You scope the fastest realistic path to a working, revenue-generating version and build it.

- I own all accounts, code, and assets.

- Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid test project before any ongoing commitment.



To Apply, Start Your Message With "AI APP BUILDER" and Include:

1. A quick intro — your background and what you build.

2. Links to 2–3 apps you've built. State clearly what part you personally built, and whether each is a live product with real users or a prototype.

3. A short video (2–3 minutes) showing one app actually working.

4. The tools you're strongest in — specifically note your experience with ChatGPT / GPT Astra and any no-code builder or AI coding tool.

5. One real technical problem you diagnosed and fixed.

6. In a few sentences: how would you approach building an AI risk/guardrails assessment tool that generates SOPs a business could hand to an auditor?

title: Law Firm Intake Specialist
description:
FIRM | Remote | Full-time

FIRM is a plaintiff-side personal injury firm looking for an intake specialist. You are the first person a potential client talks to, usually within hours of a wreck, and what happens in that conversation d
 whether they hire us or the firm on the billboard down the street.

What you will be doing

Answering new calls, web leads, and referrals quickly. Speed matters more here than almost anything else.

Running the intake interview and getting the facts that matter: how the collision happened, who was at fault, injuries, treatment so far, insurance coverage on both sides, and whether anyone has already contacted them.

Spotting the cases we want and the ones we do not, and escalating the close calls to an attorney instead of guessing.

Getting signed contracts back the same day where possible, and following up on the ones that go quiet.

Entering everything accurately into the case management system and handing off a clean file to the pre-litigation team.

Sending polite declines on cases we are not taking, so nobody is left wondering.

What we are looking for

Fluent English is required. Spanish is a strong plus and it affects pay.

Prior intake experience at a personal injury firm is preferred, but we will talk to people coming from claims, call centers, medical offices, or anywhere else that taught you how to stay warm and organized on the phone at the same time. What we need is someone who can hold a steady conversation with a person who is hurt, scared, or angry, ask uncomfortable questions without sounding like a form, and still get every field filled in.

You should be comfortable with computers and able to learn a cloud case management system. Reliable internet and a quiet place to take calls are not optional.

Compensation

Depends on experience, and bilingual candidates are paid more. Include your minimum requirement with your application.

title: People & Culture Operations Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: People & Culture Operations Specialist

100% Remote | Full-Time



We are seeking a detail-focused and highly dependable People & Culture Operations Specialist to help manage the operational side of our global HR function.



Working closely with the Head of People & Culture, you will help ensure that employee records, HR systems, payroll-related updates, recruitment coordination, training requirements, leave administration, and other People & Culture activities are handled accurately and on time.



This position is well suited to someone who is comfortable taking ownership of administrative processes, coordinating with employees and managers across different countries and time zones, keeping track of multiple deadlines, and following tasks through to completion.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:



Employee & HR Operations

-Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Head of People & Culture.

-Manage administrative activities throughout the employee journey, from hiring to separation.

-Prepare employment-related documents, including offer letters, promotion letters, salary adjustment letters, employment changes, probation documentation, and other employee correspondence.

-Organize onboarding and offboarding requirements and coordinate with the relevant stakeholders to complete each step.

-Keep employee files and HR documentation complete, accurate, and up to date.

-Record employee changes appropriately across relevant HR and payroll systems.

-Maintain HR calendars, trackers, checklists, and other tools used to monitor recurring activities and deadlines.

-Assist with recurring and annual People & Culture initiatives.

-Handle confidential employee information responsibly and use appropriate discretion.

-BambooHR & HRIS Management



Take ownership of day-to-day BambooHR administration, including:

-Updating employee profiles and employment information.

-Recording new hires, promotions, compensation changes, employee departures, and other lifecycle updates.

-Managing employee leave and time-off records.

-Keeping organizational and reporting information current.

-Supporting workflows, approvals, documentation, and employee records within BambooHR.

-Assisting with the BambooHR Applicant Tracking System and related recruitment activities.

-Preparing and maintaining HR reports.

-Regularly reviewing HR data to identify incomplete, outdated, or incorrect information.

-Assisting employees and managers with routine BambooHR-related questions.

-Looking for ways to make better use of BambooHR and reduce unnecessary manual HR processes.

-Establishing and maintaining clear procedures for HRIS administration.

-BambooHR experience is highly preferred. Candidates who have administered another HRIS may also be considered if they have strong relevant experience and can quickly adapt to new systems.



Payroll Coordination

-Support payroll administration for employees in the United States and United Kingdom by:

-Preparing and reviewing employee updates that affect payroll.

-Coordinating new employee additions and terminations with payroll.

-Processing salary increases, promotions, bonuses, and other compensation updates.

-Checking that leave and employee status changes are properly reflected in payroll.

-Reviewing payroll information for accuracy before processing.

-Maintaining supporting documentation and securing required internal approvals.

-Investigating discrepancies and coordinating necessary corrections.

-Keeping records of payroll changes and their effective dates.

-Working with Finance, payroll providers, and the Head of People & Culture when required.



Previous experience supporting U.S. and/or UK payroll administration is strongly preferred.

-Leave & Time-Off Support

-Handle the administrative coordination of employee leaves of absence.

-Keep leave-related records, documentation, correspondence, and dates accurate within the HRIS.

-Support maternity, parental, medical, and other applicable leave processes.

-Ensure required approvals and documentation are collected and properly maintained.

-Monitor key leave dates and follow up on outstanding requirements.

-Administer company time-off policies through BambooHR.

-Respond to routine employee questions concerning leave and time-off procedures.

-Escalate complex leave, legal, or employee-relations concerns to the Head of People & Culture.

-Apply leave and time-off procedures consistently according to company policies.



Recruitment Coordination

Provide administrative support across the hiring process, including:

-Arranging interviews across different time zones.

-Coordinating candidate availability with hiring teams.

-Keeping candidate information and recruitment activities updated in the ATS.

-Managing candidate communications during the recruitment process.

-Coordinating interview schedules and following up with interviewers.

-Preparing offer documentation and assisting with the candidate-to-employee transition.

-Coordinating pre-employment and onboarding requirements.

-Maintaining recruitment trackers and monitoring candidate progress.

-Supporting the Head of People & Culture and hiring managers with additional recruitment-related activities.



Training & Compliance

-Manage administrative activities within the company’s employee training platform.

-Assign required training to employees.

-Monitor completion of mandatory and role-specific training.

-Follow up on incomplete training requirements.

-Maintain training records and completion reports.

-Assist with implementing new policies, procedures, and required employee acknowledgements.

-Maintain documentation related to policy acknowledgements and other required records.

-Support compliance monitoring and reporting activities.

-People & Culture Support



The People & Culture inbox will be an important part of your day-to-day responsibilities.

You will:

-Monitor incoming employee and manager requests.

-Ensure questions and requests receive timely responses.

-Handle routine HR and policy-related inquiries when appropriate.

-Direct matters to the appropriate People & Culture team member or internal stakeholder.

-Monitor open requests until they are fully resolved.

-Follow up with employees, managers, or stakeholders when additional information or action is needed.

-Recognize urgent, sensitive, or complex matters and escalate them promptly.

-Help provide employees with a professional, responsive, and supportive People & Culture experience.



HR Policies & Compliance

-Become familiar with the company’s employee handbook, HR policies, and internal procedures.

-Support the consistent application of established HR policies.

-Maintain and update HR templates, documentation, procedures, and employee-facing materials.

-Assist with policy rollouts and employee acknowledgement activities.

-Keep current policy and procedure records organized.

-Prior exposure to U.S. and UK employment practices and employment law is preferred.

-Identify matters that require escalation rather than attempting to independently resolve complex legal or employee-relations issues.



Process Improvement & HR Organization

A key focus of this position is helping create a more organized, efficient, consistent, and scalable People & Culture operation.

You will be expected to:

-Evaluate current HR processes and identify areas where efficiency and accuracy can be improved.

-Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, trackers, and other process documentation.

-Establish repeatable approaches for recurring People & Culture activities.

-Identify manual tasks that can be simplified, standardized, or automated.

-Help clarify ownership and deadlines for recurring HR activities.

-Keep electronic employee and departmental records well organized.

-Make HR information easy to find, understand, and hand over when necessary.

-Monitor outstanding actions and ensure they are followed through to completion.

-Assist the Head of People & Culture with ad hoc projects, reporting, audits, and other operational initiatives.



What We’re Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications:

-At least 2 years of professional experience in Human Resources, People Operations, HR Operations, or a related HR function.

-Strong English communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate HR decisions and information.

-Demonstrated ability to independently manage HR administrative activities such as employee records, documentation, trackers, onboarding/offboarding, training or learning-management platforms, and recurring HR processes.

-Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, including spreadsheets, employee data, reports, trackers, and HR documentation.

-Hands-on experience with an HRIS and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) or employee management system. BambooHR experience is strongly preferred, while comparable HRIS experience may also be considered.

-Excellent attention to HR data accuracy, documentation, organization, and confidentiality, particularly when handling compensation, payroll, leave, and employment information.

-Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to prioritize tasks, solve problems, manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders, and work with minimal supervision.

-Experience using recruitment workflows and Applicant Tracking Systems.

-Experience administering an employee training or learning-management platform.

Ability to work comfortably with spreadsheets, electronic employee records, and data reports.





Working Hours: 6:00 PM – 2:00 AM Philippine Time

title: Case Manager - Lemon Law
description:
Summary

**Remote | California Lemon Law Firm | Full-Time

 

** We are a California law firm focused on lemon law and consumer protection litigation, and we are looking for a licensed attorney to join our team as a Case Manager. 

 

This is a hands-on position for an attorney who can manage cases, communicate directly with clients, stay on top of deadlines, and move cases forward from intake through settlement. 

 

## What You’ll Do 

* Manage an assigned caseload from intake/retainer through settlement or resolution. 

* Communicate directly with clients, provide case updates, answer routine questions, and maintain strong client relationships. 

* Request, review, and organize documents and evidence from clients. 

* Review purchase documents, repair orders, warranty records, service history, manufacturer communications, and other case-related documents. 

* Analyze case facts and identify missing information, potential issues, and case strengths/weaknesses. 

* Draft legal documents, including pleadings, discovery, meet-and-confer correspondence, declarations, motions, settlement documents, and other case-related correspondence. 

* Prepare and file documents with the court and assist with e-filing as needed. 

* Track case deadlines, hearings, discovery obligations, settlement deadlines, and other important dates. 

* Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and other members of the team. 

* Maintain accurate and organized case files and case-management records. 

* Follow cases closely and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. 

* Escalate significant legal or case issues when attorney review or strategy decisions are needed. 

 

## What We’re Looking For **Required:** 

 

* An active attorney license in good standing. 

* Experience handling lemon law cases OR civil litigation. 

* Strong legal writing and analytical skills. 

* Excellent communication and client-management skills. 

* Ability to independently manage multiple cases and competing deadlines. 

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment. 

* Professional, responsive, and comfortable communicating directly with clients. 

 

## Preferred 

* Direct California lemon law experience. 

* Experience handling cases from intake through settlement. 

* Experience with pleadings, discovery, motions, settlement negotiations, and court filings. 

* Experience using case-management software such as Filevine. 

* Experience working in a remote law-firm environment. 

 

## The Ideal Candidate 

We are looking for someone who can own their cases rather than simply complete individual assignments. You should be comfortable communicating with clients, reviewing documents, drafting legal work, managing deadlines, coordinating with the team, and keeping a case moving without needing to be reminded about every next step. If you have lemon law experience, that's a strong advantage. If you have solid civil litigation experience and can learn the firm's lemon law process, we are also interested in speaking with you. 

 

## How to Apply 

 

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction explaining your relevant lemon law or civil litigation experience. 

 

### Important 

Read Before Applying To confirm that you have read the entire job posting, include the title and author of the latest book you've read in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include the code word may not be considered.

description:
HOURS

9:00am to 5:00pm Australian Eastern time, Monday to Friday. 

You must be online and responsive across these hours.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We run several YouTube channels and social media accounts and publish daily. You design the visuals for all of it. 



Half the job is thumbnails that get clicked. The other half is social media graphics that get engagement. 



You will report directly to the Chief Marketing Officer and work with a small content team.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



YouTube thumbnails. 50% of the role. You know what drives click-through rate: faces, contrast, three words or fewer, readable on a phone. You deliver options fast, you test variations, and you track which ones win.



Social media graphics. 50% of the role. Instagram posts and carousels, 
 and
 graphics, quote cards, stat graphics, announcement posts. You understand what stops the scroll on each platform and why some posts get shared and others get ignored. You design for the feed, not for a portfolio.



Documents. When required, PDFs, guides, one-pagers and presentations built to our brand guidelines. Clean layout, consistent fonts, ready for screen or print.



Brand consistency. We have multiple brands with their own colour and logo rules. You follow them exactly.



YOU HAVE



A portfolio with YouTube thumbnails AND social media graphics in it. Both are checked before anything else. 

Missing either one and you will not get an interview.



Proof your work performs. Channel names, CTR numbers, engagement figures or growth you contributed to.



A working knowledge of what gets engagement on Instagram, 
 and
, and how each platform differs.

Canva at an expert level. Most of the work happens in Canva. 



Photoshop is a plus for cutouts and retouching.



Strong written English. You read briefs and reply to feedback in English all day.



Speed. Same-day turnaround on thumbnails and single social graphics, two to three days on carousels and multi-page PDFs.

Responsiveness. 



When we message you between 9 and 5 AEST, you answer within minutes, not hours.

Reliability. Time tracking on, deadlines hit, no chasing.

Basic video editing in CapCut or Premiere.

Experience designing for trades, home services or franchise brands.

### Architecture, Real Estate Development and Rental Properties



We are looking for a talented, detail-oriented Squarespace designer and digital content coordinator to help redesign, maintain and grow the online presence of a Phoenix-based architect, developer, builder and property owner.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We need someone with strong visual judgment who understands minimalist, photography-driven websites and can help generate greater awareness, website traffic and qualified leasing inquiries for our rental properties.



### About Us



Our work focuses on design-driven urban infill housing in Phoenix, Arizona. Completed projects have been published by ArchDaily and Dezeen.



Current websites:



* Architectural portfolio: [
](
)

)



We want to clarify the separation between the architect’s professional portfolio and the rental-property brand while maintaining a consistent design identity.



### Website Responsibilities



* Review and recommend improvements to both existing websites

* Redesign the architectural Squarespace website while preserving its clean, minimalist character

* Improve the LoftsPHX rental website to make availability, property information and tour requests easier to find

* Create strong project pages for VLoft, Polker and the M-Shaped Bungalows

* Improve typography, spacing, image sequencing and visual hierarchy

* Ensure excellent presentation on desktop, tablet and mobile

* Compress and optimize images without noticeably reducing quality

* Use custom CSS when Squarespace’s standard settings are insufficient

* Establish a clear connection between the Sin Hei Kwok and LoftsPHX brands



### Rental Marketing and Audience Growth



The candidate will also help increase awareness, qualified website traffic and leasing inquiries for our rental properties.



Responsibilities may include:



* Develop a practical digital-marketing strategy for LoftsPHX rental properties

* Improve local SEO for relevant Phoenix apartment and rental searches

* Create individual, search-friendly property and availability pages

* Improve calls to action for availability, inquiries and tour scheduling

,
 Marketplace and other rental listings

 content calendar

* Prepare posts highlighting available units, architectural features, neighborhoods and the rental experience

* Help establish separate but connected architecture and rental social-media identities

* Build and maintain a prospective-renter inquiry or waitlist system

* Track website visits, inquiries, tour requests and other useful performance indicators

* Provide a short monthly report explaining what content is generating traffic and inquiries

* Recommend improvements based on actual results

* Follow fair-housing-compliant marketing and advertising practices



The goal is not simply to gain followers. The goal is to increase meaningful awareness of the properties and generate qualified prospective-renter inquiries.



### Ongoing Responsibilities



After the initial redesign, the selected candidate may continue helping with:



* Adding new projects, awards and press coverage

* Updating property pages and rental availability

* Preparing website and social-media content

* Creating consistent Instagram post and story templates

* Organizing our photography and project-content library

* Making routine Squarespace updates

* Checking links, formatting and mobile presentation

* Monitoring basic website and social-media performance



### Required Qualifications



* Strong experience with Squarespace 7.1

* Portfolio showing at least three Squarespace websites you personally designed or built

* Excellent typography and layout skills

* Experience with architecture, interior design, photography, luxury real estate or another design-focused industry

* Experience with SEO, local search and image optimization

* Understanding of social-media content strategy

* Excellent written English and attention to detail

Experience with Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile or social-media scheduling tools is helpful.



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to data entry, generic Canva templates or WordPress without substantial Squarespace experience.

The initial website-redesign phase is expected to require approximately 10–15 hours per week for 4–8 weeks. After completion, there may be ongoing part-time work of approximately 3–5 hours per week.



The schedule can be flexible. Some communication overlap with Arizona business hours is helpful but not required.

Shortlisted candidates will be offered a paid 3–5-hour trial assignment. The trial will involve proposing or creating a draft redesign for one project or rental-property page. No unpaid design tests will be requested.

Please begin your application with the word **VLOFT** so we know you read the complete posting.
