title: Senior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Team Growth and Standards: Help grow our junior editors and improve how we work. You will share what you know, give clear feedback on their edits, and streamline our editing practices, templates, and workflows so the whole team moves faster and more consistently.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Required): Proven, hands-on experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. This is a senior role, so we expect you to own complex, high-resolution RAW workflows from day one.



Leadership and Process: You can mentor less-experienced editors, give clear and useful feedback, and tighten how the team works. You make the people and the process around you better, not just your own edits.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $8.00 to $15.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $1,280 to $2,400 USD per month (about 78,000 to 146,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $640 to $1,200 USD per month (about 39,000 to 73,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** Read This Before You Apply as a Senior ***



Calling yourself a senior editor does not make you one here. Neither does a year count. Five years of cutting UGC, ads, and social content is five years of real work, but it is not the work this role does, and it will not qualify you for it.



Senior at EVP means you have already done the following on paying jobs, not on spec and not on personal projects:



- A real body of finished long-form work, delivered to clients, through an approval process that had consequences when you got it wrong

- Ownership of a RAW pipeline end to end. Camera originals, proxy generation, conform, cross-camera matching. Not just cutting proxies that someone else prepared for you

- Hands-on finishing of heavy acquisition formats: RED RAW, ARRI RAW, BRAW, Sony RAW or equivalent. Light prosumer codecs alone do not count

- Sustained structure across long runtimes, with pacing driven by the information, not by retention tricks

- Rescuing projects that arrived broken, with a method you can explain

- Leading or mentoring other editors, setting conventions, and reviewing their output



If you have not done most of that, apply to the Junior Video Editor post instead. That is a real role and it is not a consolation prize. Applying for senior without the work behind it just wastes your apply points and my time.



Everyone who applies gets asked to prove this with runtimes, client names, camera formats, review structure, and specifics. Plan on that up front.



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.



***On your portfolio: Send me real work, not volume. Do not send a reel, a montage, or a folder with fifty UGC ads, TikToks, and social cuts in it. A montage tells me nothing about whether you can structure a piece. I want links to complete finished videos, with the runtime stated, and a one-line note on what you were responsible for on each.



If you do not have long-form finished work, say so directly in your application. That is a fair answer and it will not get you thrown out for Junior Editor consideration. Padding the link with short-form to make the portfolio look full will.***



- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- We expect senior applicants to record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. It is not a hard requirement, but at this level skipping it is a missed opportunity. title: Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team and help turn data into actionable insights for our clients and internal teams.



This role will be responsible for collecting, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources to help the business understand performance, identify trends, measure results, and make better decisions.



The ideal candidate is highly proficient with spreadsheets and reporting tools, comfortable working with large amounts of data, and able to take complex information and turn it into clear, easy-to-understand insights.



You will work closely with Client Success, Marketing, Operations, and other teams to develop reporting, analyze performance, identify opportunities, and improve the way we use data across the organization.



Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Reporting

Collect, organize, clean, and validate data from multiple sources.

Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and potential issues.

Develop recurring and ad-hoc reports for internal teams and clients.

Create dashboards and reporting tools that clearly communicate performance.

Monitor key performance indicators and identify significant changes or anomalies.

Translate raw data into meaningful business insights and recommendations.

Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and easy to understand.

Marketing & Client Analytics

Analyze marketing and advertising performance across multiple channels.

Review campaign, lead, conversion, traffic, and customer performance data.

Help identify which channels, campaigns, and strategies are producing the strongest results.

Support Client Success teams with data and insights for client meetings and business reviews.

Assist with developing client-facing reports and presentations.

Identify trends that may impact client performance and proactively communicate findings.

Help establish and maintain consistent reporting standards across clients.

Data Management

Maintain accurate and organized datasets and reporting systems.

Clean and standardize data from multiple platforms.

Identify duplicate, missing, or inaccurate information.

Perform data validation and quality checks.

Maintain documentation for reporting processes, data sources, and calculations.

Ensure data is consistently defined and reported across teams.

Dashboards & Automation

Build and maintain dashboards using tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

Develop advanced Excel and Google Sheets reporting systems.

Automate repetitive reporting processes whenever possible.

Identify opportunities to reduce manual data entry and reporting.

Work with internal teams to improve data collection and reporting workflows.

Business Intelligence

Provide data-driven recommendations to leadership and department heads.

Support forecasting, trend analysis, and performance planning.

Conduct root-cause analysis when performance changes unexpectedly.

Help teams understand what the data is telling us and what actions should be taken.

Develop new reports and analysis based on business needs.

Required Qualifications

2–4+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, or a related role.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

Experience working with large datasets.

Experience creating reports and dashboards.

Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

Ability to identify trends and translate data into actionable insights.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Ability to work U.S. business hours.

Technical Skills



Experience with several of the following:



Microsoft Excel

Google Sheets

Looker Studio

Power BI

Tableau

SQL

Google Analytics / GA4

CRM data

Marketing platforms

Data visualization

Data cleaning and validation

Reporting automation

API or data integrations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with digital marketing or advertising data.

Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, PPC, or other digital marketing platforms.

Experience working with CRM systems.

Experience with APIs or pulling data from multiple platforms.

Basic SQL knowledge.

Experience creating client-facing reports.

Experience working with U.S.-based companies or clients.

Experience with AI tools and automation.

Experience in the home-services or advertising industry.

What Success Looks Like

Reports are accurate, timely, and easy to understand.

Teams have reliable data to make business decisions.

Client reporting is clear and actionable.

Manual reporting processes are continuously reduced through automation.

Data quality and consistency improve across the organization.

Trends and performance issues are identified before they become larger problems.

Leadership and Client Success teams can quickly understand what is happening in the business and why.

Data becomes a valuable tool for improving client performance and operational efficiency.

title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Video Editor and Strategist
description:
We're looking for an AI-first video editor and social media strategist who genuinely loves short-form content and shows up with the plan. If you study what's working on each platform, use AI as a daily working partner, and would rather tell us what to make than wait for a shot list, we'd love to hear from you. This role is mainly for Evident Elements, a clean electrolyte brand.



The Role



You'll find and analyze videos across platforms, spot what's performing and why, and give clear direction on what we should be making next. You're not just editing what you're handed. You're d
 what gets made.



You'll edit short-form video knowing what actually performs per platform. A cut that wins on TikTok is not the same cut that wins on Reels or Shorts, and you understand those differences in your bones.



You'll partner with our team to turn that direction into a steady output of content that moves the brand forward. We work as a team to win, and you lead the thinking on your part of it.



What success looks like in the first 30 to 60 days: you're showing up with a point of view. You can tell us what's working, what isn't, and what you want to test next. You've spotted patterns in our content and competitors' content that we hadn't, and you're driving the content direction rather than waiting on a brief. The bar is strategic ownership, not task completion.



Schedule



You'll work part-time hours that fall somewhere between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST. We'll set the exact schedule together. Just want to make sure you can work somewhere inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before sending anything off.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be making, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Platform fluency. You know what does well on TikTok versus Reels versus Shorts, and you can explain why, not just guess.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.

Include editing tools, AI tools, scripting and research tools, content calendar systems, anything you've built around your workflow. - What did you do for them?

- If you have current clients, where are those accounts today?



We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI

- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.

1. If you joined next week, walk me through how you'd figure out what content we should be making. What would you look at, and what would your first hypothesis to test be?

2. Walk me through how you find and analyze videos to d
 what's worth modeling. What signals tell you a video is actually working versus just got lucky?

4. Why do you love this work? Tell me about a recent video or 
nt that reminded you why you do it.

title: Google Ads Expert (e-commerce)
description:
We're looking for an Google Ads expert (2+ years experience preferred) for **ecommerce** who genuinely loves this work and shows up with the plan. If you light up when you're building a Search or PMax campaign from scratch, use AI as a daily working partner without letting it do your thinking for you, and prefer driving strategy over taking tasks, we'd love to hear from you. Our company is evident electrolytes, a clean, electrolyte supplement brand. 



## The Role



- You'll build and manage multiple Google Ads (and Microsoft Ads) accounts from the ground up, exclusively for ecommerce clients.

- Most of the work lives in Search and Performance Max, with other campaign types layered in when the account calls for it.

- You'll partner with our team to win. We share the wins and we share the work, but you'll lead the thinking on the accounts you own.

- Success in your first 30 to 60 days looks like you showing up with the plan. You're telling us what we should be testing, why, and when. You have a clear point of view on what's working across each account, what isn't, and what you want to try next. The bar is strategic ownership.



## Schedule



You'll work part-time hours that fall somewhere between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST. We'll set the exact schedule together. There's a real path to full-time as the work grows, so we'd love to know you're open to that conversation down the road. Just want to make sure you can work somewhere inside that window.



## What We're Looking For



- **An AI-first mindset, with your own judgment doing the driving.** You use AI as a real working partner every day — for research, drafting, analysis, and speed — but the strategy, the diagnosis, and the final call are yours. We're not looking for someone who feeds a prompt to AI and forwards the output.

- **Independent problem-solving.** You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before sending anything off.

- **A strategy-first approach.** You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be doing, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- **Deep comfort in Google Ads, GA4, and Search Console.** You can navigate them without thinking and read the data without guessing.

- **Ecommerce-specific paid search experience.** You understand product feeds, ROAS targets, shopping campaigns, seasonality, and how PMax behaves with a real product catalog behind it. This is not a lead-gen role — we want someone whose instincts are built for ecommerce.

- **A real love for this work.** That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



## How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order.



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need.

   - Google Ads /10

   - GA4 /10

   - Search Console /10



   Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with a /10. Include Microsoft Ads if you've used it, AI tools, spreadsheets you've built, niche platforms, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 ecommerce clients or accounts.

   - What size was the account when you started (ad spend, revenue, ROAS, whatever metric fits)?

   - What did you do for them?

   - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

   - If you have current clients, where are those accounts today?



   We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



## How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better.



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a task in Google Ads where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why — we want to hear where you draw the line and rely on your own judgment instead



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



## A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you took over a Google Ads account on day one for an ecommerce client, walk us through what you'd want to look at in your first week and what your first hypothesis to test would be.

2. Walk us through how you'd diagnose a Search or Shopping campaign that's spending well but not converting. What do you check, in what order, and why?

3. Tell us about a time you disagreed with a client or stakeholder about how a Google Ads account should be structured. What did you push back on, how did you handle it, and what happened?

4. Why do you love this work? Tell us about a recent campaign or 
nt that reminded you why you do it.

5. What's changed about how you structure and signal Google Ads campaigns in the last 12 months (PMax asset groups, product feed optimization, AI Max for Search, broad match plus smart bidding, whatever you've adjusted to)? What's working for you right now and what isn't?

6. Are you open to a performance based pay structure? You would receive a base per hour/salary rate + bonuses for hitting certain  ROAS, sales, and other revenue metrics. This way if you’re confident in your abilities, and you can do it well, you’ll end up making much more than just a salary.

- Success in your first 30 to 60 days looks like you showing up with the plan. You're telling us what we should be testing, why, and when. You have a clear point of view on what's working across each account, what isn't, and what you want to try next. The bar is strategic ownership.



Schedule



You'll work part-time hours that fall somewhere between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST. We'll set the exact schedule together. There's a real path to full-time as the work grows, so we'd love to know you're open to that conversation down the road. Just want to make sure you can work somewhere inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before sending anything off.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be doing, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort in Google Ads, GA4, and Search Console. You can navigate them without thinking and read the data without guessing.

- Experience running paid search across both ecommerce and lead generation. Both motions are part of the work, so you should be confident in each.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order.



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need.

- Google Ads /10

- GA4 /10



Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with a /10. Include Microsoft Ads if you've used it, AI tools, spreadsheets you've built, niche platforms, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts.

- What size was the account when you started (ad spend, revenue, lead volume, whatever metric fits the role)?

- What did you do for them?

- What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

- If you have current clients, where are those accounts today?



We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better.



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a task in Google Ads where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you took over a Google Ads account on day one for an ecommerce or lead gen client, walk us through what you'd want to look at in your first week and what your first hypothesis to test would be.



2. Walk us through how you'd diagnose a Search campaign that's spending well but not converting. What do you check, in what order, and why?



3. Tell us about a time you disagreed with a client or stakeholder about how a Google Ads account should be structured. What did you push back on, how did you handle it, and what happened?



4. Why do you love this work? Tell us about a recent campaign or 
nt that reminded you why you do it.



5. What's changed about how you structure and signal Google Ads campaigns in the last 12 months (PMax asset groups, search themes, AI Max for Search, broad match plus smart bidding, whatever you've adjusted to)? What's working for you right now and what isn't?

title: Amazon Paid Media & Growth Manager (Latin America)
description:
Amazon Paid Media & Growth Manager

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Amazon Paid Media & Growth Manager to lead paid media strategy, customer acquisition, and performance growth across a large portfolio of brands on Amazon.

This is not a traditional PPC campaign management role. Our campaigns are supported by an external advertising partner responsible for day-to-day campaign execution and optimization. This role will sit above campaign execution, using advertising, organic, competitive, and profitability data to determine where we should invest, where we should scale, where we should pull back, and where the greatest opportunities exist to acquire new customers and grow market share.

The ideal candidate combines deep Amazon advertising expertise with a broader growth marketing and customer acquisition mindset. This person should be able to turn complex performance data into actionable growth strategies and work cross-functionally with our analytics, brand, organic, content, and external advertising teams.

Key Responsibilities

Growth & Customer Acquisition Strategy

• Own the strategic direction of Amazon paid media with a primary focus on profitable customer acquisition, incremental growth, and market-share expansion.

• Identify opportunities to acquire new customers through non-branded, category, competitor, and discovery-focused advertising strategies.

• Evaluate where advertising is generating incremental business versus where spend may be subsidizing sales that would have occurred organically.

• Develop strategies for conquesting competitors, entering new keyword markets, defending market share, and accelerating priority products.

• Build paid media strategies for new product launches, hero products, seasonal opportunities, and high-velocity events including Prime events and Black Friday/Cyber Monday.

• Evaluate the customer journey and determine how paid media can support awareness, consideration, conversion, and repeat purchase.

Amazon Advertising Strategy

• Analyze performance across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, Sponsored Display, and other relevant Amazon advertising opportunities.

• Evaluate performance using TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC, organic rank, impression share, profitability, and customer acquisition metrics rather than optimizing toward a single advertising KPI.

• Identify opportunities to increase investment, reduce inefficient spend, test new strategies, and improve overall advertising efficiency.

• Analyze branded versus non-branded performance and determine the appropriate investment strategy for each.

• Evaluate keyword-level and ASIN-level performance to identify areas of opportunity and diminishing returns.

• Partner on DSP strategy and evaluate opportunities for upper-funnel and retargeting investment.

Organic + Paid Growth

• Work closely with the Marketplace/Brand and Analytics teams to understand how advertising impacts organic visibility and total business performance.

• Evaluate relationships between paid search activity, organic ranking, conversion, traffic, and total sales.

• Identify products where the primary issue is discoverability versus conversion and recommend the appropriate growth strategy.

• Use search-volume, keyword-ranking, competitive, and category data to identify whitespace opportunities.

• Ensure advertising strategy supports broader brand and marketplace objectives rather than operating independently from organic strategy.

Agency Partnership & Strategic Oversight

• Serve as the primary strategic counterpart to our external Amazon advertising partner.

• Review agency recommendations and performance and determine whether strategies align with company growth and profitability objectives.

• Challenge recommendations when appropriate and bring additional opportunities to the agency based on internal analytics and business priorities.

• Translate internal findings into clear advertising initiatives for agency execution.

• Establish testing strategies, success criteria, and measurement plans before significant investments are made.

• Hold external partners accountable for performance, execution, and agreed-upon strategic initiatives.







Analytics & Performance Insights

• Analyze advertising performance alongside total sales, profitability, organic performance, inventory, pricing, promotions, and competitive activity.

• Identify the “why” behind performance changes, not simply report what happened.

• Develop actionable recommendations from large datasets and communicate findings clearly to leadership.

• Conduct competitive advertising and keyword analyses to identify areas where competitors are gaining or losing share.

• Partner closely with internal analytics resources to identify trends and build growth opportunities.

• Create regular performance reporting that focuses on business outcomes, opportunities, risks, and recommended actions rather than campaign-level activity alone.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Marketplace, Analytics, Content/SEO, Affiliate, Operations, and Brand teams to create integrated growth strategies.

• Provide paid-media insights that can influence PDP optimization, SEO strategy, promotions, pricing, inventory planning, and product launches.

• Collaborate with organic marketplace teams to ensure paid and organic strategies reinforce one another.

• Communicate priorities and recommendations clearly to internal stakeholders and executive leadership.

Qualifications

• 4–6+ years of Amazon advertising or Amazon growth marketing experience, preferably managing significant advertising budgets or multiple brands/categories.

• Deep understanding of Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and the Amazon advertising ecosystem.

• Demonstrated experience developing advertising strategy, not solely executing or optimizing campaigns.

• Strong understanding of customer acquisition, incremental growth, market share, competitive conquesting, and full-funnel marketing.

• Advanced understanding of TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, CVR, organic ranking, impression share, and profitability.

• Ability to analyze advertising performance in the context of total Amazon business performance.

• Experience working with or overseeing an Amazon advertising agency or external campaign-management partner strongly preferred.

• Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel/Google Sheets capabilities.

• Experience with Amazon analytics and research platforms such as Seller Central, Vendor Central, Helium 10, Data Dive, SmartScout, Keepa, or similar tools.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to turn complex data into concise recommendations for both internal teams and senior leadership.

• Experience managing a multi-brand or large-ASIN portfolio strongly preferred.

description:

title: BD Manager - Crypto DeFi Partnerships (Uncapped Bonuses)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn, email, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Amazon Wholesale  Product Sourcing VA
description:
We are a UK-based Amazon business looking for a reliable and detail-oriented **Amazon Wholesale Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant** based in the Philippines.



Your main responsibility will be researching profitable wholesale products and identifying brands, distributors, and suppliers that could be suitable for our Amazon business.



This is a long-term position for someone who understands Amazon product research or is willing to learn our sourcing criteria and processes.



### What you will do



* Research profitable wholesale products to sell on Amazon

* Analyse Amazon listings and sales data

* Research brands, distributors, wholesalers, and suppliers

* Review supplier price lists and catalogues

* Compare wholesale prices against Amazon selling prices

* Calculate estimated profit and ROI

* Check sales rank and estimated monthly sales

* Analyse competition and number of FBA sellers

* Check whether Amazon itself is selling on the listing

* Identify potential IP, brand, or listing risks

* Look for products with consistent sales history

* Record sourcing opportunities accurately in Google Sheets

* Contact suppliers when required

* Keep clear records of brands and suppliers researched

* Follow our sourcing criteria and SOPs carefully



### Tools you may use



Experience with any of the following is useful:



* Keepa

* SellerAmp SAS

* Amazon Seller Central

* BuyBotPro

* SmartScout

* Google Sheets / Excel

* Google search

* ChatGPT and other AI research tools



You do not need experience with every tool, but **Keepa & SAS knowledge is highly desirable**.



### What makes a good wholesale lead



We will provide our exact buying criteria, but generally we will be looking at factors such as:



* Consistent sales

* Healthy profit margin

* Good return on investment

* Stable pricing

* Reasonable competition

* Suitable number of FBA sellers

* Reliable Buy Box activity

* No obvious price wars

* Products that can potentially be reordered regularly

* Reliable UK suppliers, wholesalers, or distributors



We are not simply looking for random profitable products.



We want **high-quality, repeatable wholesale opportunities** that could become long-term products for our Amazon business.



### Working hours



* **4 hours per day**

* **5 days per week**

* Approximately **20 hours per week**

* Remote position

* Philippines-based applicants preferred

* Long-term position



There may be opportunities for increased hours, higher pay, and performance bonuses as you become more experienced and consistently find profitable products.



### Who we are looking for



The ideal candidate is:



* Very detail-oriented

* Good with numbers

* Comfortable using spreadsheets

* Patient with product research

* Able to research independently

* Reliable and consistent

* Good at following detailed instructions

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Comfortable learning new software

* Interested in Amazon and e-commerce



Previous experience sourcing products for **Amazon UK wholesale** is a major advantage.



Experience specifically with Amazon UK is preferred, although candidates with Amazon US sourcing experience are also welcome to apply.



### Application instructions



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Details of any Amazon sourcing experience you have

3. Which Amazon marketplaces you have worked with

4. Which sourcing tools you have used

5. Your experience with Keepa

6. Your experience with SellerAmp or similar software

7. How many hours you are available each week

8. Your expected hourly or monthly rate



If you have previous sourcing experience, please also send an example of a sourcing spreadsheet or explain how you normally d
 whether a wholesale product is worth buying.



Please remove any confidential information belonging to previous employers.



### Short sourcing test



Shortlisted applicants may be given a small sourcing test.



For example, we may provide a supplier website, price list, or brand and ask you to analyse several products.



We will be looking at:



* Your understanding of Keepa

* Profit calculations

* ROI

* Competition

* Sales history

* Buy Box behaviour

* Your ability to identify potential problems

* The quality of your reasoning



We care more about **finding a few genuinely good opportunities** than submitting dozens of poor-quality leads.



**Important:** Start your application with the words **“WHOLESALE SOURCING”** so we know you have read the full job description.



### Long-term opportunity



We want someone who can eventually take ownership of a large part of our product sourcing process.



As you develop, the role may expand into:



* Supplier outreach

* Opening wholesale accounts

* Analysing supplier catalogues

* Negotiating pricing

* Replenishment analysis

* Purchase order preparation

* Inventory planning

* Brand research

* Managing supplier relationships



If you perform well, there will be opportunities for **more responsibility, increased pay, and performance-based bonuses**.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Architect — Build a U.S. Law Firm's Security Stack
description:
Senior Cybersecurity Architect — Build a U.S. Law Firm's Security Stack



Remote, Philippines · One-month fixed-fee build with a path to ongoing work



USD $3,500 flat for a one-month Phase 1 build, plus USD $500 if you start within 5 business days and clear the day-14 milestone. Ongoing oversight is negotiated afterward, priced from the threat assessment you write.



The client: a U.S. law firm, fewer than 12 remote staff, Microsoft 365, holding Protected Health Information and privileged work product. No legacy security stack, no committee. You design from a blank page and report directly to the owner who quickly d
. The firm is named to finalists once the confidentiality agreement is signed.



The money. USD $3,500 or about ₱220,000 — the upper end of the Philippine security-architect range for a month. A contractor fee, not a salary: no employer contributions, no 13th month, Philippine taxes yours.



Schedule. Fully remote, likely permanently. Your own hours plus one weekly hour with the owner, in your morning or evening. If an office opens in Metro Manila or Cebu (Makati, BGC, IT Park) — no sooner than January 2027, und
 — on-site is optional, never required.



Where We Are, and the Question We Most Want Answered

Today each laptop runs its own software and does its own computing. Firm data lives in cloud storage that syncs down to every machine, e.g., Google Drive, so a local index of client files stored in the cloud is on every endpoint. We need you to ensure compliant security is designed at every vulnerability.



Two decisions we need made together:

• Where computing and data should live. Harden what we have under Microsoft 365 Business Premium; move compute and data off the endpoint with Cloud PCs or virtual desktops; browser-only access on locked-down devices; or different models by role, with certain staff treated differently than other staff.



• What the firm syncs with. Whether Google Drive stays on a plan and configuration that will hold up with a signed business associate agreement, or whether we consolidate onto, e.g., SharePoint and OneDrive under the same tenant that runs our identity and
 — with sync policy, external sharing controls, permissions, retention and legal hold, version history and ransomware rollback, audit-log retention, and PHI data-loss prevention all designed as one thing rather than bolted on.



We lean toward MS Business Premium or a hybrid solution and need to know whether it suffices here, where exactly it stops, what add-ons it needs, and the approximate all-in cost per seat. Tell us what you would need to know before answering. Saying, “I’m not sure but will figure it out” always beats a confident guess or wrong answer.



Phase 1 implements the model we approve. If your recommendation needs more hours than the band below, quote it and we will scope a change order rather than squeeze it. A quality deliverable always beats cut corners.



Phase 1 — The Build, 80 to 120 Hours

Think the scope is too large for one month, or priced too low? Say so in your application. That counts for you, not against you.



• Endpoint and data-location model: a written recommendation on where compute and data should live, with licensing tiers, per-seat cost, and tradeoffs stated plainly — then implementation of the approved model for Attorneys and paralegals, and another for heightened security for support staff.



• Cloud sync and storage: the platform decision above, implemented — including migration from current storage with no loss of file history, a permissions model, external sharing and link-expiry controls, sync restricted so that unmanaged devices cannot pull local copies, retention and legal-hold settings compatible with litigation obligations, version history and ransomware recovery, audit-log retention, and a signed business associate agreement with whichever provider we land on.



•
: SPF, DKIM, DMARC — monitoring in week one, quarantine by day 14 with every legitimate third-party sender inventoried, enforcement by final acceptance unless your report gives a specific reason to hold — plus anti-phishing, BEC and impersonation protection, and outbound forwarding restrictions.



• Identity: MFA everywhere, phishing-resistant for administrators; a conditional access baseline; legacy authentication off; separate admin accounts and least-privilege roles; a break-glass account held by the owner.



• Endpoints: an Intune-or-equivalent baseline on every remote computer in both countries — full-disk encryption, EDR deployed and alerting, patch enforcement, least-privilege local administration — plus an enforceable acceptable-use and device policy and written onboarding and offboarding checklists.



• Closing deliverables: a threat assessment and risk register in plain English an attorney can act on; a written i
-response plan; a runbook complete enough for a successor, which is a condition of final payment; and your scope and monthly rate for Phase 2 and ongoing oversight, with a managed detection and response recommendation.



We pay for the licensing and tooling your design requires, within a budget agreed before you build. 



Phase 2 — advanced data-loss prevention, mail encryption, zero-trust refinement, and whether the firm needs a server at all — is priced from your assessment and not guaranteed.

Before any access, you sign confidentiality, work-product, and data-processing agreements with the firm directly, work only from a secure and compliant device, and hold a named administrator account that is never the only Global Administrator. We verify certifications with the issuing bodies and speak with two references first. No subcontracting, and no firm or client data into any third-party or AI service without written authorization. No exclusivity — keep your other clients, but disclose any engagement adverse to ours, i.e., competing law firms we may be opposing.



What Comes After – Ph Employer of Record following Ph Labor Law

Phase 1 is fixed-fee with no guaranteed second month. Do not leave a job for it. But a firm holding this data does not secure itself once. Ongoing work — program oversight, i
 response, quarterly threat assessments, vulnerability management, staff training, and vendor and third-party risk review — is paired with a managed detection and response service we pay for, so you oversee a program rather than watch a queue. If it follows, we intend to employ you through an established Philippine employer of record: employment contract, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th month pay, statutory leave. An intention, not a promise.



Pay, in USD

Milestone 

* Signed scope agreement, accepted architecture design and platform recommendation: $1,200

* Day 14 — DMARC at quarantine, MFA and conditional access live, endpoint baseline deployed: $1,300

* Final acceptance — all Phase 1 deliverables, runbook included: $1,000

* Fast-start bonus — started within 5 business days, day 14 met on time: $500



Pay is fixed in USD so will fluctuate when converted to PHP via international payment platform. Out-of-scope work is a written change order; if we cancel mid-phase, accepted milestones are paid and work in progress is paid pro rata. Full commercial terms go to shortlisted candidates.



You

• 8+ years in security, 3+ as the final word on design decisions.

• Microsoft 365 and Entra ID depth — conditional access, Defender, Intune, Purview, mail flow, DMARC taken to enforcement on a live production domain — and fluency in licensing boundaries: Business Premium versus E3 and E5, Defender for Business versus Defender for Endpoint, what needs a Purview add-on. We spend on your advice.

• Hands-on with enterprise file sync and storage at the policy level: SharePoint and OneDrive, or other similar, including sync controls, external sharing governance, retention, and a migration you have actually run.

• Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, or equivalent taken to production.

• I
 response you can describe concretely: what happened, what you did, what changed.

• Excellent written English; half this job is explaining risk to attorneys who d
 from what you write.

• Able to start within 5 business days and finish Phase 1 inside one month, with reliable internet, a backup connection, backup power, and a habit of documenting without being asked.

• Preferred: current CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP, GIAC, or Microsoft security certification; legal, medical, or financial client data; NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or ISO 27001; the Philippine Data Privacy Act.



Apply

Subject line: SENTINEL — Security Architect. Without it, we do not read it.



1. CV, certifications with numbers and expiry dates, and two references for the finalist stage.



2. Under 300 words: one architecture you designed and implemented end to end — what was exposed, what you built, how you knew it worked.



3. Under 250 words: fewer than 12 remote staff in two countries, PHI in cloud storage syncing full local copies to every laptop, Microsoft 365 for mail and identity. What do you change first, what platform do the files end up on, and what would you need to know before committing to that answer? Include a rough all-in cost per seat.



4. Under 100 words: is Phase 1 achievable in one month at 80 to 120 hours? If not, what would you cut or move to Phase 2, and why?



5. Earliest start date, location, internet and power setup, confirmation that a weekly live call in your morning or evening works, and a rough monthly range for ongoing oversight.



Finalists complete a short written exercise on a synthetic environment — paid whether or not we engage you — then a video

title: Junior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.



***On your portfolio: Send me real work, not volume. Do not send a reel, a montage, or a folder with fifty UGC ads, TikToks, and social cuts in it. A montage tells me nothing about whether you can structure a piece. I want links to complete finished videos, with the runtime stated, and a one-line note on what you were responsible for on each.



If you do not have long-form finished work, say so directly in your application. That is a fair answer and it will not get you thrown out. Padding the link with short-form to make the portfolio look full will.***



- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.
