title: Carrier Sales Agent
description:
Drive carrier growth by building lasting relationships with owner-operators and small fleets. Remote-friendly with occasional travel.

As a Carrier Sales Agent, you will be responsible for acquiring new carrier accounts and growing relationships with active carriers on the 123Loadboard platform. You'll act as a trusted advisor — understanding the challenges owner-operators and small fleets face finding consistent loads and reducing empty miles — and demonstrate how 123Loadboard solves those problems. This role spans the full sales cycle from cold outreach to onboarding, with a focus on new account acquisition.



Job duties -

Prospect and reach out to owner-operators (1–3 trucks) and small fleets to build relationships that result in increased carrier activations on the platform.

Independently manage the full sales cycle from discovery and qualification through to account activation.

Contact prospective carriers through cold calls, emails, and social outreach to generate a consistent pipeline.

Host web meetings and conduct live product demos, showcasing how the platform helps carriers find loads and cut empty miles.

Evaluate inbound interest and collaborate with product and operations teams to align carrier needs with platform capabilities.

Occasionally attend industry events, trucking expos, and trade shows to build brand presence and source new leads.

Job responsibilities -

Serve as a brand advocate for 123Loadboard, ready to make the case for the platform in any conversation.

Build and maintain strong relationships with newly acquired and existing carrier accounts to drive platform engagement and retention.

Proactively identify upsell and expansion opportunities within the existing carrier base (e.g., premium tools, additional fleet seats).

Collaborate with internal teams to align carrier feedback with product priorities and business development strategy.

Stay current on trucking industry trends, rate environments, and competitor offerings (DAT, Truckstop, etc.) to sharpen positioning.

Maintain accurate pipeline records and activity logs in CRM to support forecasting and performance reporting. Close to 200 dials per day.

title: Inbound Appointment Setter — Excellent Spoken English Required
description:
We’re looking for someone who is exceptional on the phone to follow up with inbound leads for PestLaunch.



PestLaunch helps pest control company owners in the United States grow their businesses and become more profitable.



We run paid ads that generate new leads every day. These people have already watched our content, registered for a training, or requested information.



Your job is simple: when a new lead comes in, call them FAST, have a great conversation, qualify them, and book qualified owners onto our calendar.



This is NOT cold calling random lists.



What you'll own

- Call new inbound leads within 60 seconds

- Talk comfortably with US business owners

- Ask a few simple questions to understand their business

- Determine whether they're qualified

- Book qualified leads onto our calendar

- Follow up with leads who don't answer

- Follow up with webinar registrants and no-shows

- Keep every lead updated correctly inside our CRM

- Make sure no lead gets forgotten



Every lead should eventually become one of three things: Booked → Follow-up scheduled → Not interested



Nothing sits untouched.





Who we're looking for

The #1 requirement is excellent spoken English.



You should sound natural, confident, friendly, and comfortable speaking with American business owners.



We're looking for someone who:

- Has excellent spoken English with very strong pronunciation

- Is confident making phone calls

- Can have a real conversation instead of just reading a script

- Has appointment-setting, sales, or phone experience

- Is persistent without being annoying

- Is organized with follow-up

- Responds quickly when a new lead comes in

- Is comfortable using a CRM

- Takes ownership without needing constant reminders



Experience talking with US customers or business owners is strongly preferred.





Schedule

You must be available 8am-7pm MT.



This role requires responsiveness. When a new inbound lead comes in during your shift, contacting them takes priority.



When there aren't new leads, you'll work through follow-ups, old leads, webinar registrants, no-shows, and other opportunities in the pipeline.





How we'll measure success



We care about:

- Speed to lead

- Contact rate

- Qualified appointments booked

- Show rate

- Follow-up completion

- CRM accuracy



This isn't about making the most calls. It's about turning inbound interest into qualified conversations.





Compensation



$5–$7 USD/hour depending on experience and phone ability, plus performance bonuses.



We reward performance based on qualified appointments that actually show up and clients that close.



This is a long-term role with room to earn more as lead volume and performance increase.





How to apply



Please send me:

1. A short summary of your appointment-setting / sales / phone experience.



2. A 60–90 second Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you think you'd be great at this role.



3. In that same video, pretend I just filled out a form to watch one of our free pest control trainings. Show me exactly how you would start the phone call when I answer.



4. Tell me what hours you're available in Mountain Time.



5. Tell me your desired monthly or hourly compensation.





Start your application with the words “SPEED TO LEAD” so I know you read the entire post.

title: Lead Generation Representative
description:
JOB BRIEF

As a Broker BDR, you will be the first point of contact for prospective freight broker accounts. Your primary focus is outbound prospecting — identifying brokers who would benefit from posting loads on 123Loadboard, generating interest, and qualifying opportunities before handing them off to a closing rep or advancing them yourself. You'll work a high-volume pipeline through cold calls, email sequences, and social outreach, and you'll be expected to deeply understand the broker's world: their load volume challenges, carrier sourcing pain points, and how our platform helps them move more freight with less friction.

JOB DUTIES

• Execute high-volume outbound prospecting via cold calls, email, and LinkedIn to identify and engage freight brokers who are not yet active on 123Loadboard.

• Qualify inbound and outbound leads against defined criteria (load volume, brokerage size, current load board usage) before passing to Account Executives.

• Research target accounts using ZoomInfo, FMCSA data, and LinkedIn to build accurate contact lists of decision-makers at freight brokerages.

• Conduct discovery calls to understand broker pain points around carrier sourcing, load coverage, and empty mile costs.

• Schedule and coordinate product demonstrations or intro calls between qualified prospects and the broader sales team.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all prospecting activity, lead status, and pipeline notes in Salesforce.

• Participate in industry events, webinars, and trade shows (e.g., TIA) to source new leads and represent the 123Loadboard brand.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Meet or exceed monthly quotas for qualified opportunities created and meetings booked.

• Build and maintain a healthy top-of-funnel pipeline that consistently feeds the Account Executive team.

title: HubSpot Administrator & RevOps Specialist — Long-Term Part-Time
description:
## HubSpot Administrator & RevOps Specialist — Long-Term Part-Time



### About the Role



We are a U.S.-based e-commerce company looking for an experienced HubSpot Administrator / RevOps Specialist to become our long-term go-to person for HubSpot.



This is **not a virtual assistant position** and is not intended for someone whose HubSpot experience is primarily using the CRM as a salesperson or marketer.



We need someone who has real hands-on HubSpot administration experience, ideally including experience **inheriting an existing HubSpot portal that had poor configuration, bad automation, messy data, or processes that needed to be redesigned.**



Our immediate priority is auditing and repairing our existing setup. Long-term, we want this person to own the health and continued improvement of our HubSpot environment.



### Primary Responsibilities



You will be responsible for areas including:



* Audit our existing HubSpot portal and identify configuration, data, automation, and process problems.

* Repair and improve workflows, automation, properties, lists, sequences, associations, and other configuration.

* Own CRM data integrity across contacts, companies, deals, duplicates, associations, imports, and bulk updates.

* Build and maintain sales workflows, sequences, follow-up tasks, cooldown rules, enrollment criteria, and unenrollment logic.

* Maintain pipelines and deal processes for quotes, larger opportunities, long-lead orders, and sales follow-up.

* Make email, call, task, and activity tracking reliable and useful, including Last Activity / Last Touch reporting.

* Build useful reports and dashboards for management, sales, and customer service.

* Build and maintain HubSpot Sales Playbooks.

* Manage forms, lead routing, lifecycle stages, attribution, and related HubSpot configuration.

* Troubleshoot HubSpot problems and integrations.

* Test significant changes before deploying them broadly.

* Document important configurations and processes.

* Recommend simpler, safer, or more maintainable solutions when appropriate rather than blindly implementing requests.

* Help determine whether requested functionality requires changes to our HubSpot subscription or additional HubSpot products.

* Serve as our long-term HubSpot administrator and internal subject-matter expert.



### Initial Projects



Several projects we expect to address include:



**Service Hub / Help Desk**



* Configure HubSpot Service Hub Help Desk so customer support activity can be managed in one workspace.

* Integrate support email and website chat.

* Improve ticket pipelines, routing, ownership, and reporting.

* Evaluate and improve our RingCentral integration so calls and call activity are reliably associated with the correct HubSpot records.



**BigCommerce Integration**



* Audit our existing BigCommerce ↔ HubSpot integration.

* Fix inaccurate, incomplete, duplicated, or improperly mapped customer and order data.

* Improve contact, company, order-history, status, and revenue visibility inside HubSpot.



**Customer Reorder / Reactivation Automation**



* Use HubSpot data, workflows, properties, and BigCommerce order information to identify customers who have passed their normal reorder window.

* Trigger appropriate internal tasks, notifications, and/or customer outreach.

* Design this so our team can adjust business rules without rebuilding complicated workflows.



**Reporting**

Build and improve reporting for areas such as:



* Sales activity / CRM touches

* CRM-sourced revenue

* Customer reactivation

* Calls and call outcomes

* Customer support tickets

* Support response/activity metrics

* Orders generated through phone/email

* Other management KPIs



### What We're Looking For



**Required:**



* Strong hands-on experience administering HubSpot.

* Strong understanding of HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, pipelines, associations, automation, reporting, and data management.

* Experience auditing or inheriting an existing HubSpot portal rather than only building simple setups from scratch.

* Ability to diagnose the cause of a problem before making changes.

* Strong attention to data integrity and downstream effects of automation.

* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

* Ability to explain technical HubSpot decisions in clear business language.

* Willingness to challenge a requested solution when there is a simpler, safer, or better way to accomplish the underlying goal.



**Strongly Preferred:**



* HubSpot Service Hub / Help Desk experience.

* HubSpot Sales Hub experience.

* E-commerce CRM integration experience.

* Telephony / VoIP integration experience.

* BigCommerce experience.

* RingCentral experience.

* Operations Hub experience.

* Experience with custom objects, programmable automation, APIs, or integration troubleshooting.



We do **not** expect every applicant to have worked specifically with both BigCommerce and RingCentral. Strong HubSpot architecture and integration experience with comparable systems is more important.



### Engagement



* Remote

* Part-time

* Hourly contractor

* Approximately 3–5 hours per week initially, depending on active projects

* Flexible schedule, although some overlap with U.S. business hours will occasionally be necessary

* Long-term opportunity

* Hours are expected to increase as our HubSpot usage and needs grow

* $8–$12 USD/hour depending on demonstrated HubSpot experience



We are specifically looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term resource for our company, not simply completing one project and leaving.



### How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application.



1. How many years have you personally administered HubSpot, and which HubSpot Hubs have you worked with extensively?



2. Tell us about a HubSpot portal you inherited that was already messy or incorrectly configured. What were some of the problems you discovered, and what did you change?



3. Describe one reasonably complex HubSpot workflow or automation you personally designed. Explain the enrollment criteria, branching/logic, and unenrollment or failure conditions.



4. What experience do you have with HubSpot Service Hub / Help Desk?



5. What experience do you have integrating HubSpot with e-commerce platforms, phone systems, or other external applications? Please specifically mention BigCommerce or RingCentral if applicable.



6. When a manager asks you to build something in HubSpot that you believe is unnecessarily complicated or could create future problems, how do you handle it?



7. Please provide examples of relevant HubSpot projects you have completed. Sanitized screenshots, descriptions, or a short Loom walkthrough are welcome if client confidentiality prevents you from sharing the actual portal.



8. What is your desired hourly rate and typical weekly availability?



Please begin your application with the words **"HubSpot Audit"** so we know you read the full posting.

title: Senior U.S. Accountant / Accounting Team Lead
description:
Full-time | Long-term | Work from home | U.S. Eastern-time schedule



Important: This Is a Hands-On Accounting Position



We are looking for a highly experienced senior accountant who can personally perform difficult transaction-level accounting, resolve reconciliation problems, review the work of other accountants, and help coach a growing remote accounting team.



This is not a management-only position. A substantial portion of the work will be performed directly in QuickBooks Online (or similar ERP platforms like NetSuite), Excel, Google Sheets, and client workpapers.



If you are no longer comfortable personally correcting transactions, investigating reconciliation differences, preparing journal entries, and completing monthly accounting, this position is not a fit.



About Us



We are a U.S.-based outsourced accounting and fractional CFO firm. We serve small and midsized businesses that have outgrown basic bookkeeping but do not need a full-time internal CFO or controller.



Our clients operate in several industries, including construction, professional services, e-commerce, real estate, and other multi-entity businesses. Our work includes monthly accounting, reconciliations, financial reporting, cash-flow management, cleanup projects, and CFO support.



We have an established remote accounting team in the US and the Philippines and are hiring for growth.



The Position



The Senior U.S. Accountant will work directly with the firm’s owner and support other remote accountants.



The position combines three responsibilities:



Personally performing complex accounting and reconciliation work.

Reviewing and correcting work completed by other accountants.

Helping the team improve its accounting quality, documentation, workflow, and efficiency.



Initially, approximately 70%–80% of the position will involve hands-on accounting work. The remainder will involve review, staff support, workflow coordination, and authorized client communication.



This is a long-term role. A successful candidate may grow into a formal Accounting Team Lead position based on demonstrated technical ability, judgment, communication, and leadership.



Key Responsibilities

Perform monthly accounting for multiple U.S. clients.

Complete difficult bank, credit card, loan, payroll, clearing-account, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

Investigate and correct reconciliation differences, duplicate transactions, deleted transactions, misapplied payments, and posting errors.

Review balance sheets, profit and loss statements, trial balances, and general ledgers for accuracy.

Prepare and review adjusting journal entries.

Review workpapers and accounting completed by other staff members.

Determine whether monthly accounting files are ready for financial reporting.

Identify missing accruals, unsupported balances, classification errors, personal activity, intercompany differences, and unusual transactions.

Review payroll, sales tax, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, loans, equity, and multi-entity activity.

Answer technical accounting questions from staff.

Explain errors clearly and help staff prevent them from recurring.

Distinguish preparer responsibilities from reviewer responsibilities.

Identify repeated work, duplicated effort, and inefficient accounting processes.

Monitor assigned client deadlines and time budgets.

Escalate missing information, accounting problems, and potential time overruns promptly.

Maintain accurate, specific, and contemporaneous time entries.

Communicate professionally with U.S. clients when authorized.

Maintain workflows, deadlines, and review notes in ClickUp.

Create and improve accounting procedures and workpapers.



Required Experience

At least seven years of professional accounting experience.

At least three years working with U.S. accounting, bookkeeping, CAS, outsourced accounting, or public-accounting clients.

Experience handling multiple unrelated client files simultaneously.

Experience reviewing or correcting the work of other accountants or bookkeepers.

Advanced experience with QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Online Accountant.

Strong bank, credit card, loan, and balance-sheet reconciliation skills.

Strong understanding of accrual accounting and month-end close.

Ability to prepare and review adjusting journal entries.

Experience reviewing balance sheets and income statements for errors and unusual activity.

Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Ability to explain accounting problems clearly to staff and management.

Proven ability to work independently, exercise judgment, and accept responsibility for results.

Reliable high-speed internet, a professional home workspace, and backup plans for internet and power interruptions.

Prior successful experience working a permanent U.S. night-shift schedule.



Preferred Experience

Philippine CPA designation.

NetSuite or other ERP experience.

Experience in a U.S. accounting firm or client accounting services practice.

Experience with construction, professional services, e-commerce, real estate, or multi-entity accounting.

Experience with payroll, sales tax, 1099s, and financial-report preparation.

Experience coaching or supervising remote accounting staff.

Experience using ClickUp, Google Workspace, and similar cloud-based systems.

Experience monitoring client time budgets or engagement profitability.



Working Hours

The regular schedule is Monday through Friday during U.S. Eastern business hours, beginning at approximately 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. We will consider an earlier or later start time once you have proven that you have the skills for this position.



Applicants must understand the effect of this schedule in the Philippines and be prepared to work it consistently. Preference will be given to candidates with successful long-term night-shift experience.



Compensation



$10-$25 Per Hour, depending on demonstrated experience, technical ability, review skills, and the results of the practical assessment.



This is a full-time, long-term independent-contractor position.



How Success Will Be Measured



The successful candidate will:



Complete assigned accounting accurately and on time.

Resolve difficult reconciliations efficiently.

Find accounting problems before they reach the firm’s owner.

Improve the quality of work completed by other staff.

Reduce repeated corrections and unnecessary rework.

Maintain clear preparer and reviewer responsibilities.

Escalate missing information and time overruns early.

Produce specific and supportable time entries.

Take ownership of problems.

Help other accountants become more capable and independent.

How to Apply



Begin your application with the exact phrase:



SENIOR ACCOUNTANT PLAYER-COACH



Applications that do not begin with this phrase will not be reviewed.



Please provide:



Your current résumé.

Your requested monthly compensation in Philippine pesos.

Your earliest available start date.

Your current employment status and whether you intend to retain another full-time position.

The largest number of U.S. clients you have handled simultaneously.

Your experience reviewing the work of other accountants.

The number and positions of employees whose work you have reviewed or supervised.

Your experience working U.S. Eastern hours.

Your QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Online Accountant experience.

Whether you are a Philippine CPA.



Please answer the following questions in your own words.



Question 1: Difficult Reconciliation



Describe the most difficult bank, credit card, loan, or balance-sheet reconciliation you personally resolved.

title: CLNR Studios | Script Writer
description:
Short-Form Video Scriptwriter & Content Strategist



Company: CLNR Studios  

Position: Remote, freelance or part-time  

Compensation: Competitive and based on experience  

Potential: Long-term, ongoing work



About CLNR Studios



CLNR Studios is a creative production company helping brands, founders, and professionals produce high-quality short-form video content.



We’re looking for a skilled scriptwriter and content strategist who can transform our clients’ expertise, experiences, and ideas into compelling videos that position them as credible subject-matter experts.



This role goes beyond writing dialogue. You should understand storytelling, music, pacing, audience retention, visual direction, production, and the complete creative process behind winning short-form content.



Responsibilities



- Research each client, their industry, target audience, competitors, and content opportunities

- Turn complex topics into clear, engaging, easy-to-understand scripts

- Write educational, informational, storytelling, promotional, and authority-building content

- Create powerful hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds

- Structure scripts to build curiosity and retain viewers

- Help clients sound knowledgeable, confident, natural, and authentic

- Adapt each script to the client’s unique voice, personality, and audience

- Write scripts around music, including specific songs, instrumentals, beats, or audio trends

- Structure dialogue, visuals, cuts, and transitions to match a track’s rhythm, tempo, mood, and beat changes

- Identify musical moments for emotional shifts, reveals, transitions, pauses, and visual payoffs

- Create detailed shot lists and visual directions

- Recommend B-roll, camera angles, demonstrations, props, graphics, and on-screen text

- Provide editor notes for captions, sound effects, transitions, pacing, animations, and pattern interrupts

- Generate content ideas based on client goals, audience questions, current conversations, and industry topics

- Rewrite and improve scripts based on internal feedback, client feedback, and performance data

- Collaborate with producers, directors, editors, and account managers

- Maintain organized content calendars, scripts, and approval workflows



Writing to Music



The ideal candidate understands how music influences the structure and emotion of a video. You should be able to:



- Select or recommend music that supports the intended tone

- Write concepts inspired by the mood and progression of a track

- Time dialogue, actions, and visuals around musical cues

- Mark timestamps, beats, drops, transitions, and emotional changes

- Build anticipation before a musical payoff

- Plan montage sequences that cut naturally to the beat

- Use silence and pauses intentionally

- Communicate music timing clearly to production and editing teams

- Create alternative versions when music licensing or platform restrictions require different tracks



What Every Script Should Include



- Content objective

- Target audience

- Recommended video length and platform

- Multiple hook options

- Spoken dialogue or voiceover

- Story or information structure

- Visual hook

- Shot-by-shot breakdown

- A-roll and B-roll directions

- Camera angles and framing suggestions

- On-screen text and caption emphasis

- Graphics, screenshots, props, or demonstrations

- Editing and pacing notes

- Music recommendation or creative direction

- Musical timestamps and beat cues when applicable

- Sound-design opportunities

- Pattern interrupts

- Call to action

- Alternative ending or CTA when appropriate



Requirements



- Proven experience writing scripts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar platforms

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks, retention, and audience psychology

- A strong sense of rhythm, timing, musicality, and emotional pacing

- Experience writing scripts or visual sequences around music

- Ability to establish authority without making clients sound stiff or overly promotional

- Ability to capture different voices rather than making every client sound the same

- Strong research and fact-checking skills

- Ability to write natural dialogue that sounds good when spoken aloud

- Experience creating shot lists and visual concepts

- Understanding of video production and post-production

- Awareness of captions, B-roll, motion graphics, music licensing, sound design, and editing

- Ability to accept feedback and revise work quickly

- Excellent organization, communication, and deadline management

- Ability to manage multiple clients and projects



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with founders, executives, coaches, consultants, or personal brands

- Experience writing both story-driven and educational content

- Knowledge of direct-response copywriting and calls to action

- Experience conducting client interviews or extracting content from long-form recordings

- Familiarity with social media analytics and performance-based iteration

- Basic knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, music editing, Notion, and Google Docs

- Experience working with a creative agency, production company, or music-driven content team



To Apply



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your short-form scriptwriting experience  

2. Your portfolio or writing samples  

3. Three short-form scripts you’ve written  

4. Examples of shot lists or visual directions you’ve created  

5. An example of a script or video that was structured around music  

6. Links to published videos based on your scripts, if available  

7. Your availability and time zone  

8. Your rate and typical turnaround time  

9. A brief description of your research and writing process  



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief paid test assignment based on a client profile, creative brief, and selected music track.



We’re looking for a hardworking, thoughtful, and highly creative writer who understands how to combine expertise, storytelling, visuals, and music into content people genuinely want to watch. For the right person, this can become a consistent, long-term opportunity with CLNR Studios.

title: Phone Scheduling Coordinator - US Home Inspection Company (Night Shift, Neutral English Accent)
description:
BE THE VOICE OF A 5-STAR US COMPANY. PHONES ARE THE JOB.



Upspect Home Inspections is a growing home inspection company in Arizona, USA, with a 5-star Google rating and 350+ reviews. We're hiring TWO Phone Scheduling Coordinators to answer our business line, book inspections, and take care of the real estate agents and homebuyers who call us.



This is a VOICE role. Most of your day is on the phone with Americans: agents booking inspections, buyers asking questions, and follow-up calls to online leads. If you've spent years on a US voice account and callers never guess you're overseas, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Answer inbound calls on our US business line (Quo/OpenPhone) and book inspections in Spectora (we'll train you)

- Quote pricing accurately from our pricing sheet and offer add-on services (sewer scope, pool, termite, etc.)

- Verify every booking detail: address, square footage, home age, access codes, agent contacts, services requested

- Call online leads back within minutes during your shift

- Coordinate day-of logistics with our inspectors by text and Slack

- Use our internal reference guide and AI assistant to answer questions quickly while on a call



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- NEUTRAL, NATURAL ENGLISH ON THE PHONE. This is the #1 requirement. Clear, confident, easy for Americans to understand, with no strong accent. We will test this before we look at anything else.

- 2+ years on a US-facing VOICE account (customer service, scheduling, sales, insurance, telecom, healthcare). Chat-only or
-only support does not count for this role.

- Confident, warm, and not shy. You're comfortable steering a conversation, handling a frustrated caller, and asking for the booking.

- Detail-oriented: you repeat details back, you double-check, you don't guess.

- Reliable attendance. You show up for every shift, on time, every time. Our whole team's day depends on it.

- Stable internet (25 Mbps+), quiet workspace, USB headset; backup power/internet strongly preferred.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 40 hours, 5 days a week

- Permanent NIGHT SHIFT Philippine time (Arizona daytime and evening; Manila is 15 hours ahead, so an Arizona 8 AM start is 11 PM Manila)

- Exact shift assigned at hire; one of the two positions includes Saturday and Sunday

- Apply only if permanent night shift works for your life long-term



WHAT YOU GET

- $4-$7/hour USD based on experience, paid WEEKLY

- Long-term, full-time, direct hire (not an agency)

- Paid training with the owner and operations manager

- 13th month pay (prorated for your first year)

- Raises tied to performance after 90 days

- A small, stable team that uses your feedback



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully; this is your first test)

Attention to detail is the core of this job. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.



1. Put the word OCOTILLO in the first line of your application.

2. Tell us whether you can work weekends (Saturday and Sunday) if assigned.

3. Paste a LINK to a voice recording (60-90 seconds, no script reading). Record it on 
 or upload to Google Drive with sharing set to "anyone with the link." Answer this scenario as if you're on the phone:

   "A real estate agent calls to book a home inspection for this Friday. Friday is fully booked. The agent is frustrated and says another company can do Friday. Respond to the agent."

4. Tell us about your most recent US voice account: the company/industry, how long, and what kind of calls.

5. Confirm your internet speed (speedtest link or screenshot) and that you have a USB headset.



We'll listen to your recording before we read anything else.

title: Virtual Support Specialist (Saas)
description:
Location: Remote

Organization: RecRe, Inc.

Reports to: Director of Success



Working Hours: Up to 40 hours per week within the defined coverage window of Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm EST.



RecRe’s smart lending boxes are live on 85+ campuses across the United States. When a box goes offline or a student can’t start a rental, someone needs to notice fast, take ownership, and drive it to resolution without a campus partner having to chase us down.



The Virtual Support Specialist is the first line of defense for RecRe’s fleet and, oftentimes, the first person a user interacts with when something goes wrong. This person owns i
 from detection through resolution, knows when to escalate and to whom, and leaves a clean trail behind so nobody has to reconstruct what happened.



This role reports to RecRe’s Director of Success, and RecRe’s Director of Hardware is the escalation point for any hardware and connectivity issues. Full escalation lanes are documented in the RecRe Support Flow SOP, which will be provided on day one.



Duties and Responsibilities:

1) App Support

- Answer incoming support tickets from the RecRe support panel.

- Acknowledge every ticket within 15 minutes during your coverage window.

- Classify severity accurately and fast.

- Investigate issues: attempt reproduction, review logs, and determine best next steps.

- Write bug reports to a high standard.

- Monitor tickets routed to on-campus Default Support Contacts and internal stakeholders.

- Track recurring issues and flag patterns.

- Keep ticket records current through resolution.



2) Device Networking & Connectivity

- Serve as the first line of defense for device offline and connectivity i
, owning each one from detection through resolution.

- Monitor an internal Slack channel and device health.

- Acknowledge i
 in a timely manner during your coverage window.

- Run the standard diagnostic checklist before escalating.

- Contact on-campus staff to troubleshoot.



3) General Support

- Assist team members with troubleshooting, QA, and replicating issues reported during i
 or bug reports.

- Keep the support knowledge base current. When you solve something new, write it down.

- Flag gaps in the SOP. You will see edge cases before we do, and we want to hear about them.

- Other related duties as assigned.



Required Qualifications:

- Demonstrated customer service experience, ideally technical support

- Comfort with basic networking concepts: cellular connectivity, signal strength, antenna placement, power cycling

- Strong written communication. Most of this job is writing clearly to campus staff under various pressure situations.

- High attention to detail and genuine follow-through.

- Sound judgment on severity. Knowing the difference between “this is annoying” and “this is stopping people from renting” is most of this job.

- Reliable remote work setup and the discipline to be responsive within a coverage window

- Proficiency with Slack, Google Workspace, and ticketing or CRM tools



Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with Asana and HubSpot

- Experience with IoT or connected-device fleets, Particle specifically is a bonus

- Comfort reproducing software issues in a test environment and reading application logs 

- Prior remote work experience



Who You Are:

You notice things. When a number looks wrong, you check it instead of assuming. You would rather ask a slightly awkward clarifying question than guess and be wrong in front of a customer. You take ownership of a problem without needing to be told it is yours, and you know the difference between escalating early and escalating everything.



How to Apply

To apply for this position, please complete the application on our website:

Apply for this position → 



We review applications submitted through our website rather than through OnlineJobs.ph messages.

title: PR & Affiliate Partnerships Manager – Beauty/Skincare Brand
description:
We are a U.S.-based skincare brand looking for an experienced **PR & Affiliate Partnerships Manager** to help expand our brand visibility through media, editorial, commerce, and affiliate partnerships.



We’re looking for someone who understands how to get beauty brands in front of the right editors, publishers, commerce teams, and affiliate partners — and who can proactively identify opportunities, pitch compelling stories, and build long-term media relationships.



This role combines traditional PR with affiliate and commerce media outreach, with a strong focus on securing organic and performance-driven media coverage.



## What You’ll Do



* Identify and build relationships with beauty editors, commerce editors, journalists, publishers, and affiliate partners.

* Proactively pitch Regelica products and brand stories to relevant mass media and beauty publications.

* Identify opportunities for inclusion in existing and upcoming articles, including product roundups, “best of” lists, shopping guides, reviews, seasonal features, and beauty stories.

* Research relevant articles and publications where Regelica should be featured and conduct targeted outreach for product inclusion.

* Monitor editorial calendars, journalist requests, seasonal opportunities, and trending beauty/skincare topics.

* Develop compelling PR angles and customized pitches based on our products, ingredients, brand story, launches, promotions, and consumer trends.

* Coordinate product samples with editors and journalists for testing and potential coverage.

* Build and manage relationships with affiliate and commerce partners and identify opportunities for both organic and sponsored placements.

* Work with our affiliate platforms and partners to support publisher recruitment and content opportunities.

* Maintain a media/contact database and track outreach, responses, samples, placements, and follow-ups.

* Monitor media coverage and provide regular updates on outreach, placements, and opportunities.

* Research competitor media coverage and identify publications, articles, and content opportunities where Regelica could gain visibility.



## What We’re Looking For



* Strong experience in public relations, media relations, affiliate marketing, or commerce partnerships.

* Experience working at a PR agency is a huge plus.

* Existing relationships with beauty, lifestyle, wellness, or commerce editors and publishers are highly preferred.

* Experience pitching U.S. media and securing editorial coverage.

* Understanding of affiliate marketing and commerce content is highly preferred.

* Excellent written English and strong pitch-writing skills.

* Highly organized, proactive, persistent, and comfortable managing ongoing outreach and follow-ups.

* Able to work independently and identify opportunities rather than waiting for direction.

* Genuine interest in skincare, beauty, and consumer brands.



## Big Plus



We would especially love to hear from candidates who have:



* Worked at a PR agency representing beauty, skincare, wellness, or consumer brands

* Existing relationships with beauty editors, commerce editors, and major U.S. publishers

* Experience securing placements in beauty and lifestyle publications

* Experience with affiliate networks or publisher partnerships

* Experience identifying existing high-ranking articles and pitching brands for product inclusion



## To Apply



Please send:



* A short introduction and why you’re interested in working with Regelica

* A summary of your PR, media relations, and/or affiliate experience

* PR agencies or brands you have previously worked with

* Examples of media placements or coverage you have secured

* Any experience you have working with beauty, skincare, or wellness brands

* Your availability and expected hourly or monthly rate



We’re especially interested in someone who is resourceful, relationship-driven, and proactive — someone who knows how to find the right opportunities, make the right connections, and turn those relationships into meaningful brand exposure.

title: Remote Healthcare SaaS Sales Representative | $500 Per Sale | Commission Only
description:
Remote Healthcare SaaS Sales Representative | $500 Per Sale | Commission Only

ABOUT RXPNOW



RxPNow is a white-label digital health platform that enables entrepreneurs, gym owners, medspa operators, influencers, and personal brands to launch their own branded telehealth storefronts.



Our platform handles key aspects of the customer experience, including patient intake, provider matching, prescription fulfillment, and compliance-related processes, allowing store owners to focus on building and growing their businesses.



We are a revenue-generating platform with active stores, an established business model, and a growing partner network.



We are looking for experienced sales representatives who can take ownership of opportunities, build relationships, and convert prospective store owners into paying customers.



This is a remote, commission-only sales opportunity with defined performance expectations and the potential to grow into a long-term position with RxPNow.



COMPENSATION



Earn $500 USD for every closed sale.



A closed sale is defined as a signed customer agreement with payment received by RxPNow.



Commissions are paid weekly for qualifying sales. There is no base salary or guaranteed hourly compensation.



For representatives who demonstrate strong, consistent performance, there may be an opportunity to transition into a full-time employee position and become part of RxPNow's long-term sales team.



Your earnings depend on your sales results. For illustration:



2 closed sales = $1,000 USD

5 closed sales = $2,500 USD

10 closed sales = $5,000 USD



These figures are illustrative, not guaranteed earnings.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Follow up with assigned inbound leads and interested prospects.

Identify and engage prospective store owners through outbound calls,
s, LinkedIn, and other approved outreach channels.

Develop new sales opportunities using RxPNow's target customer profiles, outbound strategy, and sales guidance.

Work with targeted prospect information and contact lists provided by RxPNow when available.

Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers' needs, business goals, and qualifications.

Present the RxPNow platform through customer-facing video calls and product demonstrations.

Handle questions and objections professionally and guide qualified prospects through the purchasing process.

Manage assigned opportunities within RxPNow's CRM, following established sales stages, follow-up requirements, and reporting expectations.

Maintain consistent sales activity and accurate pipeline records.

Collaborate with the sales team and management to improve messaging, conversion rates, and the customer experience.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for motivated sales professionals who can manage the day-to-day sales process, communicate effectively with US-based customers, and consistently develop and close new business.



The ideal candidate has:



Previous experience selling software, SaaS, or business services.

Experience with GLP-1, weight loss, telehealth, healthcare SaaS, healthcare CRM, or related healthcare services is strongly preferred.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Experience selling to US-based customers.

Strong prospecting, discovery, follow-up, presentation, and closing skills.

Experience conducting customer-facing video calls and product demonstrations.

The ability to independently manage assigned opportunities while following an established sales process.

Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate sales activity and pipeline records.

A reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.



For candidates located outside the United States, previous experience working US business hours is strongly preferred.



Previous experience in commission-only sales is also preferred.



WORKING HOURS AND PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



This position requires consistent availability during the US daytime business hours needed to support our customers.



Representatives must be available for scheduled customer calls, product demonstrations, follow-ups, and other sales responsibilities.



For candidates located overseas, this may require working evenings or overnight in their local time zone.



You must be able to maintain a consistent working schedule and remain alert, prepared, responsive, and professionally engaged during customer-facing activities.



Representatives are responsible for managing their schedules and rest appropriately so they can perform effectively during their required working hours.



You will be expected to:



Respond promptly to assigned leads and customer communications.

Maintain consistent sales activity and follow-up.

Attend scheduled customer calls, demonstrations, and sales meetings.

Follow RxPNow's CRM requirements, sales process, playbooks, and reporting expectations.

Maintain accurate and current pipeline records.

Communicate regularly with sales management and follow established direction.

Meet agreed-upon sales activity and performance expectations.



Representatives are expected to take ownership of their opportunities and manage day-to-day execution without constant supervision while operating within RxPNow's established sales process and management structure.



Customer-facing calls and demonstrations may be recorded and reviewed as part of our normal quality assurance, performance evaluation, and coaching process.



We evaluate preparation, responsiveness, communication, product knowledge, and the ability to understand and address customer questions effectively.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

An established healthcare software platform to sell.

Access to assigned inbound leads and existing sales opportunities.

Direction on target customer categories and outbound prospecting strategy.

Targeted prospect information and contact lists when available.

Sales messaging, guidance, and an established sales process.

Product training and support for customer-facing demonstrations.

A remote working environment.

Weekly commission payments for qualifying sales.

The potential to transition into a full-time employee position based on performance and business needs.

HOW TO APPLY



Our initial screening process consists of two required components:



Your current resume.

A 60–90 second video completing the RxPNow sales presentation exercise described below.



Both components are mandatory. Applications without the requested video will not advance to the interview stage.



Mandatory Video Exercise



Before recording your video, carefully review RxPNow's How It Works page:







After reviewing the information, record a 60–90 second video explaining RxPNow as though you were speaking directly to a prospective customer.



Using your own words, explain:



What RxPNow does and who it serves.

What problems the platform helps customers solve.

What you believe are its most important selling points and why they matter to a prospective customer.



We want to see how well you can independently research a new product, understand its value, and communicate that value clearly and professionally.



Please do not simply read information from the website or use a prepared script. We are interested in your ability to identify and communicate the value of the platform naturally.



Video Presentation Requirements



Because this position involves customer-facing video calls and product demonstrations, your recording should reflect the professional environment you would use when meeting with a prospective US customer.



Please ensure that:



Your face is clearly visible on camera.

Your audio is clear and easy to understand.

Your lighting and background are appropriate for a professional video call.

You present yourself professionally and communicate with confidence.

Your presentation is organized, engaging, and demonstrates that you have prepared.



You may record your video using Loom, Zoom, or another video recording tool.



Please provide a shareable link to your video and ensure it is accessible without requesting additional permissions.



Application Submission



 your resume and video link directly to:







Use the subject line:



RxPNow Sales Representative Application – Your Full Name



In the body of your
, include the words "RxPNow Sales" and your video link.



Please ensure both required items are included in your application.



We will review your resume and video before selecting candidates for interviews.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Bilingual Branch Manager - Residential Cleaning Company
description:
# Bilingual Branch Manager – Residential Cleaning Company



**MaidPro Pasadena**



**Position Type:** Full-Time – Salaried (40 hours/week)

**Work Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Required Languages:** Fluent English & Spanish

**Required Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



## About Us



MaidPro is a professional residential cleaning company focused on providing excellent customer service, supporting our cleaning teams, operating efficiently, and continuing to grow.



We are looking for a dependable, organized, adaptable, and solution-oriented Branch Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our Pasadena, California location remotely.



This is a highly interactive position. You will communicate throughout the day with customers, cleaning professionals, applicants, and company leadership by phone, text,
, and video.



## Position Overview



The Branch Manager is responsible for the daily operation and performance of the branch. This includes customer service, scheduling, employee management, sales follow-up, hiring, payroll entry, and general operational oversight.



You will work closely with company leadership and play an important role in customer retention, employee performance, staffing, sales growth, and the overall success of the branch.



Because many of our employees are Spanish speaking, **fluency in both English and Spanish is required for this position.** You must be comfortable speaking, reading, and communicating professionally in both languages.



## Primary Responsibilities



**Customer Service & Sales**



* Manage customer communication by phone, text, and

* Follow up with sales leads and estimates

* Assist prospective customers with questions and booking services

* Manage customer schedules and schedule changes

* Respond professionally to customer concerns and feedback

* Help maintain strong customer retention

* Support the growth of recurring cleaning services



**Employee Management**



* Communicate with cleaning professionals in both English and Spanish

* Manage daily employee schedules and dispatch

* Conduct phone and Zoom interviews with applicants

* Assist with hiring and onboarding new employees

* Manage attendance issues, call-outs, and schedule changes

* Conduct coaching and performance conversations

* Maintain communication with employees throughout the workday

* Support employee training and onboarding



**Daily Operations**



* Finalize and manage daily cleaning schedules

* Monitor jobs throughout the day and respond to issues as they arise

* Enter payroll information and review job completion details

* Monitor staffing levels and branch performance

* Maintain organized digital files and communication systems

* Assist with supply and inventory needs

* Provide branch updates and reporting to company leadership



## Reliability & Schedule Expectations



Dependability is extremely important in this position. 



Our cleaning teams begin working early in the morning in California and depend on their Branch Manager to be available to help with schedules, customer questions, callouts, and unexpected situations.



The person hired for this role must be consistently available and ready to work **Monday through Friday from 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time.



We understand that emergencies occasionally happen, but we are specifically looking for someone with a strong history of attendance and reliability who can be counted on to show up consistently and be available throughout the scheduled workday.



Please consider the time difference between the Philippines and California carefully before applying. You must be comfortable working this schedule long-term.



Skills & Qualifications



* **Fluent spoken and written English – required**

* **Fluent spoken Spanish – required**

* Strong verbal communication skills

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Excellent customer service skills

* Ability to multitask and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment

* Comfortable managing employees and having difficult conversations when necessary

* Comfortable using scheduling software,
, spreadsheets, messaging platforms, and other technology

* Customer service, BPO, operations, or management experience preferred

* Experience managing remote teams is a plus

* Residential cleaning industry experience is a plus but not required

* Self-motivated and able to work independently from home

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Ability to maintain a professional and distraction-free work environment



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who wants more than just a remote job. We want someone who is interested in becoming an important part of our team and growing with our company.



The right person will be dependable, proactive, professional, organized, detail-oriented, comfortable making decisions, and able to remain calm when schedules change or unexpected problems arise.



Most importantly, we are looking for someone our employees, customers, and leadership team can rely on. 



We provide training on our MaidPro systems and processes. We do not expect you to know the residential cleaning industry on day one. We are more interested in finding the right person with strong communication skills, leadership ability, reliability, and a willingness to learn.



How to Apply



**Please read these instructions carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.**



When applying:



1. Start your application with the word **PASADENA** so we know you have read the complete job posting.



2. Tell us briefly about your previous experience in customer service, BPO operations, management, scheduling, sales, or employee supervision.



3. Rate your language proficiency:

The roleYou are the engine behind clean billing and a clean client experience.



Sales closes the deal and Client Success delivers the result. Your job is to ensure every client is correctly onboarded, every scheduled payment is accounted for, every decline is chased quickly, and no cancelled client retains paid access.



This is not passive admin work. You will handle payment conversations firmly and professionally, keep multiple systems accurate, escalate risks early, and make sure revenue does not quietly fall through the cracks.





What you’ll ownClient onboarding & access

Onboard every new client into Skool, Slack, the Pay Log and billing calendar within 24 hours.

Keep client access aligned with payment status, program changes, pauses and cancellations.

Process team-member invite approvals and complete monthly program-hygiene audits.





Accounts receivable & billing

Manage daily accounts receivable across monthly subscriptions and bespoke payment plans.

Charge due payments, chase failed payments the same day, document every action, and escalate unresolved cases on schedule.

Keep renewals, upsells, extensions, pauses and program transfers accurately reflected in both billing and access systems.

Reconcile the billing calendar, Pay Log and payment processors; investigate and resolve discrepancies before they become revenue leakage.





Operational delivery

Ensure coaching-call recordings are uploaded to the client community within 24 hours.

Submit a daily EOD report with AR outcomes, declines, follow-ups and escalations.

Identify recurring errors or bottlenecks and propose practical process improvements.







What this role does not own

Coaching or advising clients on their business.

Approving refunds, discounts or contract changes — you flag the issue and make a recommendation; leadership d
.

Building or repairing Make/Zapier automations.

Running renewal/save conversations — you surface risk and the CSM owns the commercial conversation.







What success looks like

90%+ of collectable AR collected each month.

100% of failed payments contacted the same day, with the action documented.

95%+ of clients fully onboarded within 24 hours.

Zero unexplained billing variances between calendar, Pay Log and processor.

100% clean offboarding within 48 hours — no unpaid/cancelled client retains live access.

100% accurate billing/access updates within 24 hours for pauses, transfers and upsells.

Coaching recordings live in Skool within 24 hours and EODs submitted every working day.







Who we’re looking for

2+ years in billing, collections, accounts receivable or client operations within an online business.

Native-level written English and confidence having direct, professional money conversations.

Highly detail-oriented: you reconcile rather than assume, and would rather check a third time than report the wrong number.

Fast and reliable in Slack; same-day communication is non-negotiable.

Comfortable managing a large volume of payment plans and client records without losing detail.

Comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow.





Strong advantage: experience in a coaching, agency or info-product business; managing 50+ live accounts; and handling payment plans, pauses and renewals.





Compensation

$1,000/month guaranteed base

Monthly AR performance bonus:

80–84% collected: +$300

85–89% collected: +$700

90–94% collected: +$1,500

95%+ collected: +$2,000



Total earning range: $1,000–$3,000/month.





Bonus requires 100% EOD compliance and is forfeited if payments are falsely marked collected or a cancelled client retains access for 48+ hours.





First 90 days

Days 1–30: Learn the current AR process; own onboarding by day 14 and daily AR by day 21; document every billing-data gap found.

Days 31–60: Run the role independently; reach 85%+ AR collection; complete a full calendar vs. Pay Log vs. processor reconciliation.

Days 61–90: Sustain 90%+ AR collection, maintain zero access-hygiene failures, and implement one documented improvement that reduces manual work.

- Own the operational rigor behind our Maps/GBP program — SOPs, QA gates, cadence, and reporting that let the specialists deliver ranking outcomes consistently across all locations

- Forecast capacity, surface bottlenecks, and recommend re-scoping

- Maintain access hygiene across GA4, GSC, GBP, GTM, CMS, hosting, and BigQuery

- Run structured post-mortems on breaks/slips; fix root causes, not symptoms

- Regular direct communication with the SEO Manager on operational health, blockers, and priorities



You supervise the system, not the specialists. The SEO Manager, Lawrence Parmisana, leads the team. You own the operational scaffolding that makes their work consistent, accurate, and on time.



Must Have

- 5-10+ years progressive SEO, with significant time in delivery, operations, or quality management (agency or in-house)

- End-to-end Google Maps / GBP mastery — deep understanding of GBP optimization, categories, review signals, spam fighting, GBP API, and how the Maps ranking space is evolving (AI Overviews, local pack changes, category behavior)

- Hands-on experience building agentic and CLI-driven AI workflows that automate real SEO work at scale — not just chat prompting. Terminal fluency required. Working knowledge of Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Gemini CLI, or comparable; custom GPTs/agents; prompt-driven automation adopted by a team

- Judgment on AI risk — knows where AI accelerates work and where it creates E-E-A-T, YMYL, or GBP-policy exposure

- Deep AIO/GEO expertise — how AI search and generative engines rank/cite local businesses and how to optimize for them

- Home services SEO (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, or similar) or home services + deep local SEO

- Strong technical SEO — on-page, GBP, citations, schema, technical audits, CWV, indexation

- Management reporting — Power BI, Looker Studio, Sheets, or comparable

- SOP + workflow enforcement in ClickUp (preferred) or comparable

- GA4, Search Console, BrightLocal, or comparable rank tracking

- WordPress (Elementor, Yoast, Rank Math), intermediate

- Multi-location, multi-brand ops experience

- Excellent spoken and written English, with strong presentation and communication skills — you'll run team reviews, present to leadership, brief the SEO Manager and CMO, and represent the operational voice of the team

- 5+ years remote/distributed

- Reliable CST 8–5



Nice to Have

- BigQuery / data warehouse familiarity

- Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog

- Bachelor's in marketing/business/communications (equivalent experience OK)



Stack You'll Work In

ClickUp, Slack, Fellow, Ahrefs, Semrush, BrightLocal, Terminal/Git Bash, Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Gemini CLI, Git, GitHub, Screaming Frog, GA4, GSC, GBP + API, WordPress, Google Cloud, BigQuery.

- Reliable communication and ability to meet turnaround expectations

title: Small Business Bookkeeper - Xero

title: Part-Time DTC / E-commerce Bookkeeper — QuickBooks Online
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Do you have hands-on experience keeping the books for a direct-to-consumer (DTC) or e-commerce brand selling across multiple channels?



We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper to manage accounting across three companies in QuickBooks Online. You should understand how an online customer order flows from gross sales through discounts, fees, refunds, chargebacks, and platform payouts to the final bank deposit.



This position requires at least 2 years of direct bookkeeping experience supporting a DTC or e-commerce business across multiple sales channels. General bookkeeping experience alone will not meet the requirements for this role.



You will keep the books accurate, current, and ready for leadership review. You will also reconcile historical receipts, invoices, and transactions from August 2025 through January 2026 as part of your ongoing workload, with no fixed catch-up deadline.



We value someone who works independently, investigates discrepancies, communicates proactively, and handles confidential financial information with discretion and integrity.



REQUIRED DTC / E-COMMERCE EXPERIENCE



To qualify, you must have:



At least 3 years of bookkeeping experience, including 2 years supporting a DTC or e-commerce business.

Hands-on experience reconciling sales and payouts across multiple channels simultaneously, beyond Shopify alone.

Experience with at least 2 of the following: Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Marketplace, Faire, TikTok Shop, Stripe, or PayPal.

The ability to separate gross sales, fees, refunds, chargebacks, sales tax, and holds or reserves, and reconcile net payouts to bank deposits.

Experience investigating payout discrepancies using platform reports, transaction details, and bank records.

Experience cleaning up historical or backlogged books.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



DTC / E-commerce Reconciliation



Reconcile sales across 6 or more sales channels and payment processors, including Shopify and marketplaces.

Accurately record sales, fees, refunds, chargebacks, and payouts, and match settlements to bank deposits.

Investigate discrepancies between platform reports, QuickBooks Online, and bank records.

Keep transactions and balances separate for each legal entity.



Bookkeeping & Historical Cleanup



Maintain accurate books across three companies, keeping each company’s records in its separate QuickBooks Online company file.

Review, verify, and categorize automated bank feed transactions.

Upload and categorize receipts, invoices, and supporting documents.

Perform weekly reconciliation checks across 7 or more bank and credit card accounts, and complete monthly statement reconciliations.

Reconcile 
 vendor bills, invoices, and payments.

Maintain the general ledger and independently prepare journal entries for accruals, adjustments, and corrections.

Reconcile historical transactions and supporting records from August 2025 through January 2026.



Financial Reporting & Leadership Support



Prepare and review weekly QuickBooks Online reports, including Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and General Ledger.

Provide brief commentary explaining significant variances, unusual transactions, and discrepancies.

Maintain budget spreadsheets and flag differences between budgeted and actual results.

Monitor balance sheet accuracy, cash flow trends, cost increases, and margin changes.

Communicate issues proactively and follow through on resolving them.



ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS



Strong QuickBooks Online expertise, including native bank feed connections.

Experience using 
 for invoices, bills, and payments.

Strong understanding of financial statements, the general ledger, and journal entries.

Ability to manage bookkeeping across multiple companies without mixing transactions or records.

High attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

Confidence communicating findings and questions directly to leadership.

Discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial information.

Familiarity with tools such as Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, and Ramp.



HOW TO APPLY — REQUIRED



Please include both of the following:



1. A link to your resume



Your resume should clearly identify your DTC or e-commerce bookkeeping experience and the platforms you have worked with. Please make sure the link is accessible.



2. Your answers to the application assessment below



For Questions 1 and 3, begin with Yes or No, then explain your answer. For Question 2, select one answer.



Specific examples from your own work are encouraged. Please do not share confidential client information.



APPLICATION ASSESSMENT



1. E-commerce bookkeeping experience



Have you managed bookkeeping for a DTC or e-commerce business?



If yes, please describe:



Which sales channels or platforms you worked with, such as Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, wholesale, or similar.

Roughly how many transactions or how much monthly revenue you reconciled across those channels.

How you reconciled sales, fees, refunds, and payouts to bank deposits. Walk us through a specific time a payout did not tie out: what did you check, what caused the difference, and how did you resolve it?

Whether you managed bookkeeping for more than one legal entity/company at the same time, and how you kept the books separate.



2. Where does sales tax collected from customers belong on the financial statements?



A. Revenue on the Profit and Loss statement

B. A liability on the Balance Sheet until remitted

C. An expense on the Profit and Loss statement

D. Not sure



3. Sales tax compliance experience



Have you handled sales tax compliance for an e-commerce or multi-channel business?



If yes, please describe your responsibilities, including how you tracked nexus across states, filed returns, or reconciled sales tax collected through platforms such as Shopify or Amazon against amounts remitted. Clarify which tasks you handled personally and which were handled by a platform, accountant, or tax service.



Please submit your resume link and answers to all three assessment questions to be considered.

title: 3D Jewelry Designer & Renderer | Iconic American Brand
description:
3D Jewelry Designer & Renderer (Full-Time, Remote)



STUDIOCULT · www.studiocult.co



Join the Cult ↯



STUDIOCULT is one of the most innovative jewelry brands in America, and it has a devoted following around the world. We make the pieces people didn't know they needed until they saw them: rings that look like cursors, earrings made from soda tabs and carabiners, and a bag shaped like a binder clip. Every piece starts with a spark of wit and ends with serious craftsmanship.



This is a rare opportunity to be the hands behind that craftsmanship. You'll work directly with our Creative Director to bring new designs to life. Over time, you'll help shape what STUDIOCULT makes next.



The Role



Our Creative Director has been doing much of the CAD work personally. We're looking for an exceptionally talented 3D designer to take that work over, so they can focus on the bigger vision for the brand. You'll be their right hand in the design process.



This isn't a "model what's on the ticket" job. Precision matters enormously, but so does your eye. We want someone who will spot what could make a design better and speak up. As you grow with us, you'll have the chance to pitch and develop your own design ideas.



What You'll Do



- Turn sketches, references, and concepts from the Creative Director into precise, production-ready 3D models

- Create photorealistic renders in Cinema 4D (or similar) for design review, product development, and marketing

- Model with manufacturing in mind, including wall thickness, stone settings, tolerances, and casting and printing requirements

- Collaborate closely and iterate quickly through feedback rounds with the Creative Director

- Contribute design ideas and suggest new pieces, variations, and improvements

- Keep files organized and maintain consistency across collections



What You Bring



- Expert proficiency in Rhino 3D (required)

- Strong ZBrush skills for organic, sculptural, and playful forms (required)

- Rendering experience in Cinema 4D or comparable software such as KeyShot, Blender, or 3ds Max (required). You should be able to make metal, enamel, and stones look irresistible.

- A portfolio that shows exceptional precision and attention to detail

- Experience modeling jewelry for production

- A good design eye and a sense of humor about objects

- Clear communication in English and reliability with deadlines

- Several hours of daily overlap with US business hours (Eastern Time)



Bonus points for:



- Experience with render engines like Redshift, Octane, or V-Ray

- Experience with MatrixGold or other jewelry-specific plugins

- Knowledge of enamel, resin, or colored finishes

- Familiarity with 3D printing for casting

- Genuine enthusiasm for fashion, design, and internet culture



The Details



Type: Full-time

Location: Remote, open to candidates worldwide

Compensation: 15/hour (negotiable based on experience)

Reports to: Creative Director



Why STUDIOCULT



Work one-on-one with the Creative Director of a globally loved brand

See your work produced, worn, and shared by fans around the world

Real creative input: your ideas can become actual products

A long-term, full-time role with room to grow



How to Apply



Send the following in your reply to this post:



- Your portfolio, including jewelry work and both CAD models and renders

- A short note on your experience with Rhino, ZBrush, and your rendering software

- Your time zone and availability

- Your favorite STUDIOCULT piece and one thing you'd design for us

title: Manager/Guest Experience VA for Luxury Airbnb/Vrbo Management Company
description:
Guest Experience and Operations VA for Luxury Airbnb and VRBO Rentals (US Night Shift)



My company, Lunera Stays, is looking for a Virtual Assistant who is excited to join a scaling vacation rental management company with our home base in Arizona in the US. We manage luxury beach homes in the Outer Banks of North Carolina, desert homes in Sedona, AZ, a property in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico, and we are expanding to the Scottsdale/Phoenix metro area where I live. Our properties are large luxury four to eight bedroom homes with pools, booked by families who expect a five-star experience. 



We currently have 2 full time VAs and we need a third now as we are growing.

As you review the description, we welcome any questions you may have about the position or the team. The position is full time and exclusive. We are looking for someone who wants to be a part of a growing company and understands the hospitality industry.



THE MOST IMPORTANT SKILL FOR THIS ROLE

Solving guest issues and complaints with empathy, calm, and excellent negotiation and communication skills. If a guest messages at 11pm that the pool heater is not working, you are the person who gathers the facts, d
 what to do, communicates clearly, and protects both the guest's experience and our five-star reviews. Everything else in this role can be taught. This cannot. If handling difficult guest situations is not a strength of yours, this is not the job for you.



REQUIREMENTS

Strong English communication, grammar, and speaking is a requirement, not a preference. You will be on a live, unscripted video call as an early step in the process.

You must have work experience either with or for a vacation rental management company, Airbnb, VRBO, Expedia, or previous Airbnb/VRBO property management experience. 

If you do not have this experience, please do not apply.

We use OwnerRez, HostBuddy AI, PriceLabs, AirDNA, GoHighLevel CRM, RankBreeze, Ring, Turno, Slack, Loom, Ramp, Google Sheets, and Canva, and we are at the forefront of using AI systems in our operations. Several of our tools are being consolidated into an AI dashboard this year and some manual work is going away. We are looking for someone who is adaptable, learns tools quickly, and is excited by that, not threatened by it. Experience with OwnerRez or with any AI guest messaging tool is a strong plus.



POSITION OVERVIEW

Your role is to run the hospitality and operations side of our business during your shift. This includes:

- Guest communication across Airbnb, VRBO, and direct bookings, including complaints, requests, and mid-stay issues

- Verifying every turnover: cleaner arrival, completion, and photo confirmation, and escalating when a turn is at risk

- Coordinating vendors: cleaners, pool service, maintenance, hot tub, HVAC, locksmith

- Monitoring alerts from our AI pricing system and flagging exceptions (you will not be setting prices manually)

- Listing description edits and changes

- Post-stay review responses, damage reports, and guest follow-up

- Income and expense tracking for our properties

- A clear written end-of-shift handoff so the next team member starts informed

Attention to detail is paramount. We value strong problem solving skills and need someone who does not have to be directed step by step on every task. We do not expect mastery at the beginning in each of these, just a willingness to learn and to speak up when you do not understand something. We will give you clear instructions and video training for every task.

SCHEDULE

This is a US night shift. We cover our properties from 8:30am Eastern to 9:00pm Arizona time, seven days a week, so this is a seven-day rotation with two days off per week, and some weekends are included. You will need to be able to work a combination of both shifts during the week

- Shift A: 8:30pm to 5:00am Philippine time;    8:30am-5pm EST Fri & Sat

- Shift B: 3:30am to 12:00pm Philippine time;  3:30pm-12am EST Tue & Wed

Monday weekly meetings for 1-1.5hrs at 1:30p-3pm mandatory also. 

Shifts are 8.5 hours: 8 working hours plus a 30-minute handoff. Shifts may rotate through the year with the other VAs, so flexibility is needed. If you cannot commit to night schedules long term, please do not apply.

COMPENSATION

- Starting rate: $5.00 per hour, full time (30-35 hours per week, may increase to 40 hrs)

- Documented review at 90 days with a step to $5.50 per hour if performance is commensurate. 

- A real path to more as the company grows. We are a small team and there will be more senior roles as we add properties.

This role is exclusive. We are not able to hire someone who is working for other clients at the same time.

QUALITIES NEEDED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

Excellent English and communication. We are looking for someone who can be tops in hospitality in communicating with our luxury guests. Being able to empathize, negotiate, and problem solve are essential to us.

Integrity. You are a good fit if you can be honest with your fellow team members. Open communication and honesty are paramount to me and the team. If you cannot hit a deadline, or if you made a mistake, please be upfront about it. We are all human, and each of us makes mistakes.

Commitment. We are looking for someone who wants a long-term relationship with the expectation of potential growth in the company. If you are just looking for a few months of work, this is not for you.

Attention to detail. We need someone who is sharp and skilled at fact checking, editing, and proofreading before submitting information and data.

Organizational skills. You are a good fit if you are great at prioritizing, planning, setting goals and completing them, collaborating with a team, creating and keeping deadlines, record keeping, and managing time, tasks, and schedules.

Desire to learn. We are a small team and want people who are open to learning new skills and taking on projects. If you are not comfortable learning something new or asking for help, this is not the job for you.

If this sounds like you, please apply below and I will personally review your application.  In the subject line of your application or on the first line, add the term STR VA7232 so that I know you read the complete job description. At the top of your application, name the company or companies (any vacation rental company, Airbnb, VRBO, Expedia, etc.) that you have previous experience working for or with.
