title: META ADS PERFORMANCE MARKETING SPECIALIST
description:
We are looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist who can manage the entire acquisition process from the first ad impression to the final purchase.



The ideal candidate understands how media buying, creative strategy, offer positioning, and funnel performance work together.



This is a hands-on role.



You will not only analyze campaigns. You will also help create the assets and funnels needed to improve them.



YOUR ROLE



You will be responsible for:



Managing Meta/Facebook advertising campaigns

Creating and testing ad creatives

Developing new hooks and marketing angles

Writing ad copy

Building and improving landing pages

Creating simple sales funnels

Testing offers and product positioning

Monitoring campaign performance daily

Identifying performance bottlenecks

Improving campaigns based on real data

Scaling successful campaigns

Reporting results clearly to management

MEDIA BUYING



You should be confident with:



Campaign setup

Budget management

Creative testing

Audience testing

Retargeting

Scaling strategies

Performance analysis

Conversion tracking



You should understand metrics such as:



ROAS

CPA

CTR

CPM

CPC

Conversion Rate

AOV



We are looking for someone who understands why performance changes, not someone who only reads the numbers.



CREATIVE STRATEGY & PRODUCTION



You should be able to create your own advertising assets.



This includes:



Image ads

Video ads

UGC-style creatives

Short-form video edits

Creative variations

Hooks

Headlines

Ad copy

New marketing angles



You should regularly research competitors and understand what type of creatives are currently working in the market.



Strong creative judgment is very important for this position.



FUNNEL & LANDING PAGE WORK



You should be able to build or improve:



Product pages

Landing pages

Advertorials

Pre-sell pages

Offer pages

Upsells

Bundles

Checkout flows



You do not need to be a developer.



However, you should be comfortable working with common page builders and making practical conversion-focused changes yourself.



HOW YOU WILL WORK



You will continuously look at the full customer journey:



Ad → Click → Landing Page → Offer → Checkout → Purchase



When performance drops, your job is to identify the weak point.



For example:



Weak CTR → improve creative or hook

Strong CTR but weak sales → investigate funnel or offer

High CPA → review campaign structure, creative quality and conversion rate

Strong campaigns → create variations and scale

TEAMWORK



You will communicate regularly with:



Store Creators

Operations Team

Creative Team

Management

Other Media Buyers



Good communication is important.



You should clearly explain:



What is working

What is not working

What should be tested next

What creative is needed

What funnel changes should be made

What resources are blocking performance

IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are a strong fit if you are:



Experienced with Meta Ads

Comfortable creating creatives yourself

Familiar with funnel building

Data-driven

Creative

Fast at testing ideas

Organized

Reliable

Proactive

Comfortable taking ownership

Strong at problem solving



E-commerce experience is strongly preferred.

title: META ADS  PERFORMANCE MARKETER
description:
Meta Ads + Creatives + Funnels | Full-Time Remote



We are looking for someone who can own the full performance marketing process.



Not just run ads.



Not just create creatives.



Not just build landing pages.



We want someone who can connect all three:



Creative → Campaign → Funnel → Conversion → Scale



You should be able to launch a product, test different angles, create ads, build the funnel, analyze the numbers, and improve the weak points yourself.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You will be responsible for turning products and offers into profitable campaigns.



Your work will include:



Launching and managing Meta Ads

Creating image and video ad creatives

Writing hooks, angles and ad copy

Building landing pages and sales funnels

Testing products and offers

Monitoring campaign performance

Improving creatives based on data

Improving funnels based on conversion data

Scaling profitable campaigns

Reporting results and next actions

META ADS



You should be comfortable with:



Campaign setup

Creative testing

Audience testing

Retargeting

Budget optimization

Scaling

Campaign analysis

Pixel/conversion tracking

Managing multiple campaigns simultaneously



You should understand metrics such as:



ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, CPC, CVR and AOV



But more importantly, you should understand what those numbers are telling you.



CREATIVE PRODUCTION



You will create your own creatives.



We expect you to be able to:



Research competitor ads

Find winning creative concepts

Create video ads

Create image ads

Edit short-form videos

Create UGC-style creatives

Write strong hooks

Write ad copy

Create multiple variations quickly

Turn winning creatives into new iterations



You do not need to be a professional designer.



You need to understand what sells.



FUNNEL BUILDING



You should also be able to build and improve:



Product pages

Landing pages

Advertorials

Pre-sell pages

Offer pages

Upsells

Bundles

Checkout flows



If an ad gets clicks but people are not buying, we expect you to investigate the funnel instead of immediately blaming the campaign.



HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO THINK



Example:



High CPM?

Look at audience, account, creative and market.



Good CPM but bad CTR?

The creative or hook may be weak.



Good CTR but bad conversion rate?

Check the landing page, product, offer and funnel.



Good conversion rate but bad ROAS?

Analyze CPA, AOV, pricing, margins and campaign structure.



We want someone who thinks like a business operator, not just an Ads Manager user.



PRODUCT & COMPETITOR RESEARCH



You should regularly research:



Competitor ads

Competitor stores

Landing pages

Offers

Hooks

Pricing

Bundles

Customer problems

New creative angles



You should be able to take a product and answer:



Who buys this? Why do they buy it? What angle will make them stop scrolling?



WORK STYLE



We value people who are:



Fast

Proactive

Independent

Data-driven

Creative

Organized

Comfortable testing aggressively

Good communicators

Able to take ownership

Focused on results rather than activity



You will communicate with our Operations Team, Store Creators, Creative Team and Management.



If something is blocking performance, we expect you to communicate it immediately.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You only know how to launch campaigns

You depend on other people for every creative

You cannot build or edit a landing page

You only follow instructions without giving ideas

You do not analyze your own numbers

You wait several days before reacting to poor performance

THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF



You can look at a product and think:



“I know how I would market this.”



Then actually create the ads, build the funnel, launch the campaigns and improve everything based on the data.

title: Emergency Operations Coordinator
description:
Emergency Operations Coordinator

Department: Community Operations

Reports To: Director of Operations / Director of Community Management

Schedule: Friday – Tuesday, 5:30 PM to 2:00 AM Pacific Time

Primary Coverage: Evenings, weekends, and U.S. holidays

Position Type: Full-Time / After-Hours Operations

Payrate: $950/Month

Role Summary

The Emergency Operations Coordinator provides after-hours operational coverage and administrative support for HOA communities during evenings, weekends, and holidays when the regular management team may be unavailable.

This position serves as the primary point of contact for urgent and emergency community matters during assigned hours. The Emergency Operations Coordinator is responsible for receiving emergency calls, assessing the nature and urgency of the issue, coordinating with approved vendors when appropriate, documenting i
, and escalating significant matters to the appropriate Property Manager or leadership team.

This position does not independently manage an HOA portfolio. Matters requiring management decisions, Board authorization, financial approval, interpretation of governing documents, or decisions regarding HOA responsibility or liability must be escalated to the appropriate Property Manager or leadership team.

During periods of lower emergency call volume, the Emergency Operations Coordinator provides administrative and operational support to the Community Management and Operations teams. Responsibilities include organizing association records, uploading and categorizing documents, maintaining electronic community files, reviewing open tasks, assisting with work-order documentation, and completing assigned administrative projects.

The ideal candidate is calm under pressure, highly organized, responsive, capable of following established emergency procedures, and comfortable balancing emergency response responsibilities with administrative work.

Key Responsibilities

After-Hours Emergency Call Coordination

• Serve as the primary after-hours contact for assigned HOA communities.

• Answer and respond to emergency and urgent homeowner, Board member, and community calls.

• Assess incoming calls to determine whether an issue requires immediate action, escalation, vendor dispatch, or regular business-hour follow-up.

• Coordinate responses to common HOA emergencies such as active water leaks, flooding, gate or access failures, common-area electrical concerns, property damage, sewage backups, elevator issues, and other urgent common-area conditions.

• Contact approved emergency vendors according to established company procedures.

• Escalate significant i
 to the assigned Property Manager or leadership team.

• Contact emergency services when a situation involves an immediate threat to life or safety.

• Maintain professional communication with homeowners, Board members, vendors, and internal team members.

• Avoid making commitments regarding HOA liability, insurance coverage, reimbursement, financial responsibility, or Board decisions unless specifically authorized.

• Maintain detailed records of emergency calls, actions taken, vendors contacted, communications, and required follow-up.

Weekend & After-Hours Operations Support

• Provide operational support for communities during weekend and after-hours periods.

• Review and respond to urgent homeowner and Board inquiries within the scope of the position.

• Monitor open community issues requiring after-hours follow-up.

• Responsible for administrative works such as uploading files and documents to the proper folders.

• Coordinate with vendors regarding active work orders and emergency service requests.

• Document unresolved matters and prepare clear handoff notes for the assigned Property Manager.

• Follow established HOA policies, company procedures, emergency protocols, and escalation requirements.

• Ensure matters requiring management decisions are properly escalated rather than independently d
.

• Ensure non-emergency matters are documented and communicated to the appropriate team for regular business-hour follow-up.

Administrative & Document Management

When emergency call volume permits, the Emergency Operations Coordinator will perform assigned administrative responsibilities, including:

• Organize association documents and electronic records.

• Upload documents into the appropriate HOA management platform or document management system.

• Categorize and file documents in the appropriate association folders.

• Rename and organize documents according to company naming conventions.

• Organize governing documents, meeting records, financial documents, insurance documents, contracts, vendor records, correspondence, and other association records.

• Maintain accurate and organized digital association files.

• Identify missing, duplicate, incorrectly categorized, or incomplete documents.

• Assist with document transition and onboarding projects for newly managed associations.

• Update community information and internal records when authorized.

• Perform assigned data-entry and administrative cleanup projects.

• Review and organize open operational tasks and work orders.

• Assist Property Managers and Community Success teams with administrative projects.

• Prepare documents and information for regular business-hour staff to review and process.

I
 Documentation & Shift Handoff

The Emergency Operations Coordinator is responsible for maintaining accurate records of significant after-hours activity.

I
 documentation should include:

• Association/community name

• Date and time reported

• Homeowner, Board member, or reporting party

• Nature of the i

• Emergency classification

• Actions taken

• Vendor contacted or dispatched

• Property Manager or leadership team contacted

• Current status

• Required follow-up

• Supporting photos,
s, invoices, or documentation when available

Outstanding matters must be clearly handed off to the appropriate Property Manager or Community Operations team so that no emergency, vendor issue, or homeowner concern is lost between shifts.

Work Schedule

Regular Schedule: Friday through Tuesday

Regular Hours: 5:30 PM to 2:00 AM Pacific Time

This position is specifically designed to provide operational coverage during periods when the regular Community Management team has limited availability.

The employee must be available to work evenings and weekends as part of their normal work schedule.

Regular days off will generally occur on Wednesday and Thursday, subject to operational needs and the final schedule established by the company.

U.S. Holiday Coverage

The Emergency Operations Coordinator is part of the company's after-hours and holiday emergency coverage team.

The employee may be scheduled to work or provide on-call emergency coverage during U.S. holidays when the regular office is closed, including Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, and other recognized company holidays.

When scheduled for holiday coverage, the company may provide an alternative scheduled day off or adjust the employee's work schedule in accordance with company policy and applicable employment requirements.

For example, if the employee is scheduled to provide emergency coverage on Thanksgiving Day, another day during the applicable schedule may be designated as the employee's day off.

Holiday schedules and coverage expectations will be communicated in advance whenever reasonably possible.

Emergency Escalation Expectations

The Emergency Operations Coordinator is expected to follow established procedures to determine whether an issue requires immediate vendor coordination, emergency services, management escalation, or next-business-day follow-up.

Situations requiring immediate attention may include active flooding or significant water intrusion, fire or smoke, major common-area electrical hazards, building access failures creating a security concern, significant property damage, elevator emergencies, sewage backups, fallen trees, structural hazards, or other conditions presenting an immediate health or safety concern.

The Emergency Operations Coordinator should not independently make Board-level, financial, legal, insurance, or property management decisions unless specifically authorized under established company procedures.

Qualifications

• 1–3+ years of experience in HOA/property management support, customer service, facilities coordination, hospitality, emergency dispatch, call center operations, administrative support, or a related field preferred.

• HOA or residential property management experience preferred.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to remain calm and professional during emergency situations.

• Strong judgment and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently while following established procedures.

• Strong organizational and administrative skills.

• Comfortable handling calls from homeowners and Board members.

• Experience organizing electronic documents and maintaining digital records.

• Comfortable working with property management platforms, CRM/ticketing systems, Google Workspace,
, and cloud-based document storage.

• Ability to accurately document i
 and prepare clear handoffs.

• Availability to work evenings, weekends, and assigned U.S. holidays.

Core Competencies

Emergency Triage — Correctly distinguishes emergencies from urgent and routine matters.

Communication — Communicates calmly and professionally with homeowners, Board members, vendors, and internal staff.

Coordination — Effectively coordinates vendors, internal staff, and follow-up without exceeding the authority of the position.

Organization — Maintains accurate records and efficiently organizes association documents and administrative information.

Reliability — Provides consistent after-hours coverage and responds promptly to assigned calls and tasks.

Independence — Works effectively with limited direct supervision while following established procedures and escalation requirements.

Attention to Detail — Accurately records i
, communications, documents, and follow-up requirements.

Performance Metrics

Performance may be evaluated based on:

• Emergency call response time

• Emergency triage accuracy

• Emergency response and escalation time

• I
 documentation completeness

• Vendor coordination and dispatch response time

• Number of missed or unanswered emergency calls

• Successful handoff of unresolved matters

• Administrative task completion

• Document upload and organization accuracy

• Timeliness of assigned projects

• Compliance with emergency and escalation procedures

• Homeowner and Board communication quality

Role Expectations

The Emergency Operations Coordinator provides reliable operational coverage when the regular management team is unavailable.

The coordinator is expected to respond promptly to legitimate emergencies while recognizing that not every homeowner request requires immediate action. Matters that can reasonably wait until regular business hours should be documented and routed to the appropriate team.

During periods without active emergency calls, the employee is expected to remain productive by completing assigned administrative, document management, community organization, and operational support work.

The overall objective of the Emergency Operations Coordinator is to provide dependable after-hours emergency coverage, maintain continuity between the after-hours and daytime teams, and provide additional administrative support to Community Operations.

About Beyond Intelligence.ai



Beyond Intelligence.ai is an AI-driven healthcare startup building next-generation environmental intelligence for pediatric medicine.



Modern pediatric care operates under constant environmental pressure—air pollution, temperature volatility, humidity swings, allergens, and atmospheric instability—all of which directly influence respiratory events, allergy flare-ups, patient surges, and clinic strain.



Our platform transforms these invisible forces into calm, actionable intelligence that allows care teams to anticipate problems instead of reacting to crises.



We are hiring directly for an outbound sales professional to help introduce this missing layer of intelligence to pediatric clinics across the United States.



The Nature of the Role



This is a full-cycle outbound sales position designed for someone who excels at steady, professional outreach and values clarity over aggression.



You will be responsible for initiating contact, guiding conversations, running working sessions, and managing relationships from first touch through long-term retention.



This is not transactional selling.



You are helping clinical leaders recognize a structural blind spot—and showing them how it can be resolved.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your core activities include:



Identifying and researching pediatric clinics



Conducting outbound calls and professional follow-ups



Scheduling and leading structured 30-minute sessions



Explaining how environmental intelligence impacts pediatric operations



Enrolling clinics into an ongoing service



Maintaining active client relationships and light account management



You will own the process end-to-end, from first outreach to active, supported client.



The Product You’ll Represent



Our platform continuously interprets environmental signals that affect children’s health, including air quality, atmospheric patterns, and biological triggers.



Clinics already experience the downstream effects:



Asthma spikes



Allergy surges



Volatile call volume



Staff burnout



Reactive care cycles



What they’ve never had is visibility.



Beyond Intelligence.ai provides that visibility—quietly, continuously, and without operational burden.



There are no dashboards to manage and no software complexity.

The system operates in the background, delivering clarity instead of noise.



Who You’ll Speak With



Your conversations will primarily involve:



Pediatric practice owners



Clinic administrators and operations managers



Leadership teams overseeing multiple locations



These professionals are capable, overextended, and time-constrained.

Your ability to communicate calmly and clearly is essential.



Compensation Structure



Base Pay: PHP 25,000 – PHP 40,000 per month



Commission: USD 99.90 per active clinic you personally source



Commission is monthly and recurring for as long as the client remains active.

HOURS AND PAY

The role includes 10 paid days off per year, accrued monthly, agreed paid holidays, and an annual performance and compensation review.

title: Founder’s Operations Associate / Executive Assistant — Operations & Special Projects
description:
I run a growing U.S.-based online business and am looking for a highly organized, resourceful person to work directly with me on operations and special projects.



This is an operations-heavy, execution-focused role working directly with the founder — not a traditional calendar-and
 Executive Assistant position.



I spend a significant amount of time developing business strategy, designing systems, solving problems, and identifying new initiatives.



I need someone who is especially good at taking those ideas, decisions, projects, and sometimes messy information and helping turn them into clear, organized, completed execution.



Sometimes you will receive a clear plan and be responsible for executing it.



Other times, you may receive only an objective or partially defined problem. In those situations, you should be comfortable researching the problem, organizing the relevant information, identifying unanswered questions, developing possible approaches, and presenting a concise picture so we can quickly d
 how to proceed.



For important projects, I often want to understand and help architect the execution plan myself. Your job is not to remove me from important decisions. Your job is to remove the unnecessary research, organization, coordination, follow-up, and administrative work surrounding those decisions — and then help drive the resulting plan to completion.



For routine, inexpensive, and reversible work, you should increasingly be able to make reasonable decisions and proceed independently.



Examples of Work You May Handle



Your responsibilities may include:



Turning discussions and decisions into organized projects



Preparing possible execution plans for founder review



Tracking initiatives, open loops, blockers, and next actions



Conducting operational research



Researching vendors, software, tools, and alternatives



Producing concise decision briefs



Coordinating implementation after decisions are made



Following up with team members, contractors, and vendors



Organizing hiring processes



Supporting employee/contractor onboarding and offboarding



Maintaining operational documentation



Building and updating SOPs and checklists



Organizing accounts, access, files, and information



Coordinating work involving different specialists



Taking non-specialist operational work away from technical team members



Finding forgotten, blocked, or stalled work



Collecting operational metrics



Identifying recurring work that should be standardized



Structuring processes so they can eventually be automated



Helping protect founder and specialist attention



The exact work will vary. This is a generalist operations role rather than a narrowly defined repetitive position.



The Person I'm Looking For



Your previous job title matters less than how you operate.



You create clarity from messy information.



You can take scattered messages, documents, requirements, research, and unfinished ideas and determine what is happening, what matters, and what needs to happen next.



You close loops.



If something was started but never actually completed, you notice.



You don't confuse:



“I sent the message”



with:



“The problem is solved.”



You can figure things out.



Incomplete instructions do not cause you to immediately stop and ask for step-by-step directions.



You research, investigate, make reasonable assumptions, and move forward where appropriate.



You also know when NOT to act independently.



Being resourceful does not mean being reckless.



You should learn the difference between an inexpensive, reversible decision you can make yourself and an expensive, sensitive, or consequential decision that should be brought to me.



You communicate concisely.



If you spend two hours investigating something complicated, I usually should not need two hours to understand what you found.



A strong outcome might be a short summary containing:



what matters,



what you found,



what you recommend,



and what decision, if any, you need from me.



You follow through.



If a vendor doesn't respond, information is missing, or a project encounters friction, you don't simply allow the project to disappear.



You determine the appropriate next action.



Useful Skills



Experience with some of the following is helpful:



ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools



Google Docs and Google Sheets



Excel



Notion, ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or similar tools



Online research



SOP and documentation creation



Vendor coordination



Hiring administration



Remote-team operations



Basic technical/software concepts



WordPress



Zapier, Make, or other automation tools



You do not need to be a programmer or WordPress expert.



Strong candidates could come from backgrounds such as:



Executive Assistant



Operations Assistant



Operations Associate



Project Coordinator



Startup Operations



Virtual Assistant



Administrative Operations



Research/Implementation roles



What This Role Is NOT



This is not primarily:



Calendar management



 management



Data entry



Customer service



Social media management



Website production



Software development



A repetitive task-based VA position



Some administrative work will exist, but the larger purpose is operational execution and follow-through.



Hours



The position will begin at approximately 15–20 hours per week.



There is potential for additional hours and responsibility if you demonstrate strong judgment, reliability, independence, and the ability to take meaningful operational work off the founder and other team members.



Compensation



$5–$7 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated capability and experience.



AI Use



Using AI is allowed and encouraged.



I care about the quality of your judgment and final work, not whether you used AI to help you research, organize, or produce it.



Simply copying generic AI output without thinking about it will not be useful in this role.



Hiring Process



I care more about demonstrated ability than interviewing skill.



The hiring process will likely include:



Short application and operational exercise



Short paid practical assessment for selected candidates



Paid working trial for finalists



The exercises are designed around realistic operational situations rather than trivia or academic questions.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your résumé, CV, or relevant work profile



2. Your desired hourly rate in USD



3. The number of hours per week you can reliably work



4. Your normal working hours/time zone



5. A short introduction video — approximately 60–90 seconds



In your video, please briefly tell me:



Who you are professionally



What type of work you're particularly good at



One example of a time you took something unclear, disorganized, or unfinished and helped move it forward



Why this particular role interests you



A simple webcam or phone recording is completely fine. No professional editing or production is expected.



You may use Loom, Google Drive, an unlisted YouTube video, or another simple video-sharing service.



Before submitting, please verify that anyone with the link can actually view the video.



Selected applicants will receive the next step of the application process.



If you're the type of person who enjoys taking something messy and turning it into something clear, organized, actionable, and complete, I'd like to hear from you.

title: Growth Marketing & Automation Operator | Part-Time Remote
description:
About VibeKast



VibeKast is a technology and audience infrastructure company for film and television. We help filmmakers begin building and understanding their audiences earlier in the lifecycle of their projects, creating greater leverage as they move toward financing, marketing, and distribution.



We’re an early-stage company, which means we’re looking for someone who enjoys building, experimenting, solving problems, and turning ideas into things that actually work.



The Role



We’re looking for a Growth Marketing & Automation Operator who sits at the intersection of marketer, builder, and creative problem solver.



You’ll work directly with the Founder & CEO on marketing strategy and priorities, then help turn that direction into functioning acquisition campaigns, funnels, landing pages, automations, CRM workflows, content, creative assets, experiments, and measurable results.



Our immediate priority is building a repeatable acquisition engine that attracts and qualifies high-value filmmaker and producer prospects who are a strong fit for VibeKast.



We’re looking for someone who can think, contribute ideas, figure things out, and take ownership, not simply complete a list of assigned tasks.



What You’ll Do



Your work may include:



* Build and operate marketing funnels from acquisition through qualified lead

* Create landing pages, forms, lead capture, and qualification workflows

* Set up CRM pipelines, tagging, tracking, and follow-up systems

* Build
 nurture sequences and marketing automations

* Research and identify where our ideal filmmaker and producer prospects can be reached

* Execute digital acquisition campaigns across appropriate channels

* Contribute campaign concepts, hooks, messaging, and content ideas

* Create or help develop digital marketing assets and campaign creative

* Use AI and automation to make our marketing operation faster and smarter

* Track campaign and funnel performance and identify where prospects drop off

* Recommend and implement tests to improve conversion

* Maintain clean marketing and lead data

* Turn founder conversations and strategic direction into execution without requiring every next step to be assigned



Who We’re Looking For



We’re particularly interested in someone who is:



* A strong independent thinker and problem solver

* Both creative and analytical

* Curious about why something works, not just how to complete the task

* Comfortable moving between marketing strategy and hands-on implementation

* Able to bring ideas to the table rather than simply wait for instructions

* Willing to respectfully question an approach and recommend something better

* Resourceful when they don’t immediately know the answer

* Excited about emerging AI and automation tools

* Comfortable working in an early-stage startup where systems are still being built

* Focused on business outcomes rather than marketing activity for its own sake

* Visually discerning, with a strong sense of what feels contemporary, elevated, and appropriate for an entertainment and technology brand



Graphic design capability is a plus. If you can not only conceptualize marketing creative but also execute strong visual assets yourself, we’d especially like to see your work. We care about aesthetic judgment and visual storytelling, not simply proficiency with design software.



Technology & Tools



You do not need to know every tool below. We’re more interested in whether you understand how the pieces work together and can learn what you don’t already know.



Experience with some combination of the following is valuable:



CRM and marketing automation platforms, landing-page and funnel builders,
 marketing systems, Meta and Google Ads, analytics and attribution tools, Zapier, Make, n8n, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, AI tools, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, or other marketing and creative technologies.



If you have technical ability beyond traditional marketing, including web development, APIs, AI workflows, or lightweight coding, we’d especially like to hear about it.



What Success Looks Like



You’re successful in this role when the founder can say:



“Here’s what we’re trying to accomplish and here’s my thinking,”



and you can help turn that into:



“Here’s what we built, here’s what happened, here’s what we learned, and here’s what I recommend we do next.”



Over time, you should be able to take increasing ownership of execution and keep campaigns, systems, and experiments moving without requiring constant founder involvement.



Schedule & Compensation



Part-time, remote.



Approximately $800–$1,000 USD/month to start, depending on experience, capabilities, and agreed scope.



We’re more interested in finding an exceptional fit than filling a specific number of hours. There is room for the role and compensation to grow as VibeKast grows.



How to Apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter. We’d much rather understand how you think and what you’ve actually built.



Please send:



1. A short introduction explaining why this role caught your attention.

2. One or two examples of a marketing funnel, growth system, campaign, or automation you personally helped build.

3. Tell us specifically what you did, rather than what “the team” did.

4. What business problem were you trying to solve? What happened? What did you learn?

5. What marketing, automation, AI, and creative tools are you strongest with?

6. Tell us about something you figured out or built when nobody gave you instructions for how to do it.

7. What’s one marketing, creative, or technology idea you’ve encountered recently that you found genuinely interesting, and why?

8. If you have graphic design or creative-production experience, please include 2–3 examples of your strongest work.



Please include links to relevant work where available.

title: Business Loan Sales Consultant / Closer — Warm Leads — AU Day Shift
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Have you sold business loans, mortgages, asset finance or insurance? Bring your closing experience to Ezy Pzy Finance and help Australian business owners access funding.

We also welcome proven sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate consistent target achievement and experience closing business over the phone.

You’ll receive warm enquiries, product training, weekly coaching and the opportunity to earn commission on both new and repeat clients.





YOUR EARNING OPPORTUNITY



•During probation: AUD $500/week + commissions + bonuses (approx. ₱97,500/month fixed base). After 8 weeks probation: AUD $650/week including PhilCare allowance + commissions (approx. ₱126,750/month fixed pay).

• Our agents currently average AUD $5,200/month (₱234,000/month) in total earnings including commissions and monthly bonuses.

• Earn between AUD $100 - $800 (approximately ₱4,500–₱36,000) commission per deal..

• Repeat business stays with you: when a client you funded returns for more funding, you handle their next deal and earn commission again.

• Earn additional monthly performance bonuses based on KPI’s achieved.

After your two-month probation, benefits include the base salary increase, an HMO allowance, paid annual and sick leave, and access to higher bonus tiers.





WHO WE ARE



Ezy Pzy Finance is a fast growing Australian business finance company connecting business owners with a panel of non-bank lenders.

We’re growing our remote sales team and looking for consultants who combine strong closing skills with clear communication and disciplined follow-up.

Learn more: 





WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Call Australian business owners who have already expressed interest in funding.

• Understand their business, funding needs and timing.

• Qualify enquiries and guide clients through the application process.

• Explain available options clearly, handle objections and move deals towards settlement.

• Keep your pipeline organised and follow up consistently.

• Build relationships that generate repeat business.



Warm leads are provided. There is no cold prospecting or list building, but the role involves regular outbound calls and persistent follow-up.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



You have at least two years of phone-based sales experience and have personally been responsible for closing sales and achieving targets.



We particularly welcome sales experience in:



• Business lending or merchant cash advance campaigns.

• Australian or US mortgage and asset finance.

• Insurance, debt solutions or other financial products.



Successful closers from other industries are also encouraged to apply. Show us what you sold, your targets, your results and your role in winning the business.



You should be able to:



• Build trust and communicate confidently in spoken English.

• Run a discovery conversation and ask useful follow-up questions.

• Explain products clearly and handle objections professionally.

• Own your pipeline, maintain accurate records and follow through.

• Learn new products and apply coaching.



Finance processing, customer service or appointment-setting experience is useful, but you must also demonstrate personal closing experience.





TRAINING AND SUPPORT



Your first four weeks include structured product and sales training, with an initial focus on smaller loan facilities up to approximately A$30,000.

You’ll progress to larger deals as you meet quality and settlement milestones, supported by weekly one-to-one sales coaching.





SCHEDULE AND SETUP



• Monday–Friday, 6:30am–4:30pm Philippine time.

• One-hour lunch break; 45 working hours/week.

• Fully remote, with evenings free.

• Reliable computer, internet connection and backup internet/power arrangements required.





HOW TO APPLY



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Complete applications get a response within 48 hours.

Provide ALL 5 of the following:

A short video (3–5 minutes, Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube link) in two parts:



Part 1 — introduce yourself, your sales experience, and the results/KPIs you achieved (numbers, not adjectives).



Part 2 — a 2-minute mock opening of a discovery call: pretend you’ve just dialled an Australian business owner from Ezy Pzy Finance — do your opening, build rapport, and start qualifying them for funding.



- Link to your resume.

- Screenshots of your DISC assessment and IQ test results (tests available at 
/testcontent).

- Screenshot of your internet speed test, provider, and PC/laptop specs.

- Your backup internet and power solutions.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview, including a live discovery-call role-play.





If you’re a top performing sales professional and have the self drive to earn big commissions and grow in a company that is focused on long term success, then submit your application and we’ll see if we’re a good fit to work together.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager & Content Creator



Part-Time with Potential to Grow into Full-Time



Eliza & Co. is a real estate team serving the Greater Toronto Area, and we’re looking for a creative, social-media-savvy Social Media Manager & Content Creator to help bring our brand and content ideas to life.



We already have lots of ideas, listing footage, photos, lifestyle content, client stories, ad concepts, and trends we want to try. We need someone who can take those raw materials and turn them into polished, engaging content that feels like Eliza & Co.



We also want someone who is genuinely on top of social media trends. You should know what’s trending on Instagram and TikTok, what types of Reels are performing, what hooks and editing styles are gaining traction, and be able to identify trends we can adapt to our brand.



What You’ll Be Doing



Social Media



* Edit Reels and short-form videos from raw footage we provide

* Create Instagram carousels, graphics, Stories, and branded content

* Take our ideas, inspiration posts, or trends and creatively bring them to life

* Stay on top of trending audio, Reel formats, hooks, editing styles, and social media trends

* Proactively bring us trends and content ideas that could work for our brand

* Schedule and publish content consistently

* Help write and refine captions that fit our voice

* Engage with our audience and relevant accounts

* Repurpose existing footage and photos into additional content

* Maintain and organize our content calendar

* Review content performance and help identify what is resonating with our audience



Our primary social platform right now is Instagram, with plans to expand into TikTok in the future.



Paid Ads & Marketing Content



* Edit video creatives for
 and Instagram ads

* Turn raw footage and scripts into polished, attention-grabbing ad creatives

* Create multiple versions of ads with different hooks, openings, lengths, and formats for testing

* Edit VSLs (Video Sales Letters) and longer-form marketing videos

* Add captions, graphics, B-roll, transitions, screenshots, and other visual elements to keep viewers engaged

* Repurpose longer videos and VSLs into shorter ad and social media content

* Create supporting graphics and static creatives for paid campaigns when needed



You do not need to manage our Meta Ads campaigns. We’re primarily looking for someone who can create and edit the creative assets used in those campaigns.



What We’re Looking For



* Strong short-form video editing skills

* Strong graphic design skills with a good eye for clean, elevated visuals

* Experience with CapCut, Canva, Adobe programs, or similar editing tools

* Understanding of how editing for a paid advertisement differs from editing an organic Reel

* Ability to create strong hooks and maintain viewer attention

* Familiarity with VSL-style editing is a strong asset

* Someone who genuinely follows Instagram and TikTok trends

* Ability to recognize trends and creatively adapt them to a real estate/personal brand

* Able to take a rough idea and develop it into finished content

* Comfortable following an established brand aesthetic

* Creative, organized, reliable, responsive, and consistent

* Fluent in English



Real estate experience is a plus, but strong creative skills, taste, editing ability, and social media instincts are more important.



Our Style



Our brand is professional, modern, elevated, and approachable. We want our content to feel polished without feeling overly corporate, generic, or templated.



Sometimes we’ll give you a specific concept, script, or trend to execute. Other times, we’ll send you raw footage, photos, or an inspiration post and expect you to creatively build it out.



We’re looking for someone who can eventually become a true creative partner for the Eliza & Co. brand.



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your portfolio and/or social media accounts you’ve worked on

3. 3–5 Reels or short-form videos you’ve personally edited

4. Examples of graphics or carousels you’ve designed

5. Examples of paid social media ads or VSLs you’ve edited, if available

6. The editing/design programs you use

7. Your expected hourly or monthly rate

8. Your availability and how many hours per week you can commit

9. Any experience you have managing Instagram accounts

description:
TO APPLY

com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.

JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads, email campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via email, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Commitment to the company's mission and values, which can be found here: 



- Excel as a team player, contributing positively to our collective success.





ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS



HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. We've been family-owned and operated since 2005, now in our second generation of leadership, and are headquartered in Dallas, Texas.



We serve thousands of retailers, interior designers, department stores, and boutique hotels across the United States through four distinct brands spanning a range of styles and price points. Our growth has been recognized nationally: we've been named to the Inc. 5000 (a prestigious list of America's fastest-growing private companies) two years running, and have received multiple industry awards for product excellence.



We're a company of around 45 people, small enough that every person matters, established enough that you're joining something real and growing.



Discover more at 
.





WHY HIEND ACCENTS?



We're growing our team in the Philippines because we believe in finding the best people regardless of geography, and investing in them for the long term.



As a family-owned company, we don't treat our tea
mbers as interchangeable. We take the time to build real working relationships, we care about your professional development, and we want every person who works with us to leave with stronger skills than when they started. That's a genuine commitment from our leadership, not a line in a job posting.



What you can expect:



You'll work directly with our core team in Texas, not through layers of management or a BPO intermediary. Your contributions will be visible, your ideas heard, and your growth supported.



- Compensation & Benefits: Competitive pay benchmarked to PH market rates for skilled roles, not entry-level floors. Paid time off including vacation days and holidays, plus 13th-month pay.
